en_body: The autumn wind crosses the Yellow River by night,
stripping mulberry leaves at Yanmen Pass.
Far off I see the Tartars on their hunt,
armored horses bivouacked in the biting frost.
Five columns of troops advance by separate routes,
a lone brigade has fought a hundred battles.
Yet for all their merits they are cast into prison;
the common soldiers can only grieve in silence.

en_translation: The autumn wind crosses the Yellow River by night,
stripping mulberry leaves at Yanmen Pass.
Far off I see the Tartars on their hunt,
armored horses bivouacked in the biting frost.
Five columns of troops advance by separate routes,
a lone brigade has fought a hundred battles.
Yet for all their merits they are cast into prison;
the common soldiers can only grieve in silence.
baihua_lines: 秋风在黑夜里吹过黄河，
吹落了雁门一带的桑叶。
远远望见胡地之人正在打猎，
战马披挂着鞲衣，宿在严霜之中。
五道大军分头出兵进击，
孤军深入，身经百战。
战功卓著反而被投入牢狱，
士卒们只能暗自伤心悲痛。

Five columns of troops advance by separate routes,

Yet for all their merits they are cast into prison;

en_body: We watered our horses and crossed the autumn river,
the water was ice, the wind cut like a blade.
Over level sands the sun had not yet set,
and Lintao loomed dimly through the darkening air.
Of old there was a great battle by the Long Wall,
all men spoke of the soldiers' lofty spirit then.
Yellow dust has filled that place from ancient times,
white bones lie tangled among the wild weeds.

above Weiyang's front hall the moon rides high.
The singing girl of Pingyang has newly won favor,
spring chill beyond the curtain — a brocade robe is bestowed.

title: 芙蓉楼送辛渐

en_body: Cold rain joined the river as it swept through Wu by night,
at dawn I see you off — the Chu mountains stand alone.
If friends and kin in Luoyang ask how I fare,
tell them my heart is ice in a jade vase, pure and clear.
South of Danyang the autumn sea lies in shadow,
north of Danyang the Chu clouds hang deep and low.
Seeing you off from this high tower wine will not make me drunk,
on the cold quiet river the bright moon knows my heart.

en_translation: Cold rain joined the river as it swept through Wu by night,
at dawn I see you off — the Chu mountains stand alone.
If friends and kin in Luoyang ask how I fare,
tell them my heart is ice in a jade vase, pure and clear.
South of Danyang the autumn sea lies in shadow,
north of Danyang the Chu clouds hang deep and low.
Seeing you off from this high tower wine will not make me drunk,
on the cold quiet river the bright moon knows my heart.

天明时送别友人，楚山也显得孤单。

丹阳城北楚云深沉浓厚。
高楼上送别友人，喝再多酒也不能醉，
寒江寂寞，只有明月照着我的一片冰心。

en_body: Zhao Feiyan leaned on her lightness of limb,
contending with others for fame of artful smile.
The lord turned his heart away from his concubine,
stirring in her deep grievance against him.
The sun sets on the walls of Zhaoyang Palace,
autumn descends upon the long Changle Palace halls.
Desolate and empty within the golden chambers,
songs and music fall silent when night comes.

When suddenly she saw the willows' green by the road,

en_body: The traveler's road stretches beyond the green hills,
my boat glides forward on the emerald water.
The tide is full, making both shores seem endlessly wide,
the wind is true, a single sail hangs high.
From the night's last shadows the sea sun is born,
spring enters the river before the old year ends.
Where can I send a letter to my home?
Let the returning geese carry it to Luoyang's side.

en_translation: The traveler's road stretches beyond the green hills,
my boat glides forward on the emerald water.
The tide is full, making both shores seem endlessly wide,
the wind is true, a single sail hangs high.
From the night's last shadows the sea sun is born,
spring enters the river before the old year ends.
Where can I send a letter to my home?
Let the returning geese carry it to Luoyang's side.
baihua_lines: 旅人走的路延伸到青山之外，
小船行在碧绿的江水之前。
潮水涨平，两岸之间水面显得格外宽阔，
风顺波稳，一片白帆高高悬挂。
夜色未尽，海上的红日已经升起，
旧年尚未过去，江上已透露出春天的气息。
寄往家乡的书信要送到哪里呢？
请北归的大雁帮我带到洛阳那边吧。

title: 和贾至舍人早朝大明宫之作
author: 王维
note: 【和贾至舍人早朝大明宫之作】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: The red-capped cock-man calls the dawn watch tallies,
the keeper of robes brings forth the cloud-blue fur.
Ninefold palace gates swing open like heaven's doors,
envoys from ten thousand nations bow before the crown.
Sunlight first touches the immortal palm that catches dew,
incense drifts beside the dragon robe's coiling forms.
After court he must compose edicts on five-colored silk,
his jade pendants chiming as he returns to Phoenix Pool.

en_body: The Wei River winds around the old Qin frontiers,
Mount Huang still curls past the Han palace halls.
The imperial coach passes through willows of a thousand gates,
from the covered way I look back on the Upper Garden's blooms.
Two phoenix towers pierce the clouds above the capital,
spring trees in rain shield ten thousand households below.
The emperor rides with the season's yang to promulgate the calendar,
not idly touring to feast on nature's splendor.

notes.term: 奉和圣制从蓬莱向兴庆阁道中留春雨中春望之作应制
notes.explanation: 唐代王维所作的诗。

translation: 渭水自縈秦塞曲，黃山舊遶漢宮斜。鑾輿迥出千門柳，閣道廻看上苑花。雲裏帝城雙鳳闕，雨中春樹萬人家。爲乘陽氣行時令，不是宸遊玩物華。

baihua_lines: 渭水萦绕着秦地的关塞曲折东流，
黄山依旧斜抱着汉代的宫阙。
銮驾远出，穿过千门绿柳，
站在阁道上回望，上苑百花正盛。
云雾缭绕中帝都两座凤阙高耸入云，
春雨里春树葱茏，掩映着万家百姓。

并非为了游玩赏玩物华美景。

title: 山居秋暝
author: 王维
note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。

en_body: After fresh rain in the empty mountains,
the evening air breathes of autumn's coming.
Bright moonbeams filter through the pine trees,
clear spring water flows over the stones.
Bamboo stirs — washerwomen are returning home,
lotus leaves shift — fishing boats glide downstream.
Let the spring fragrance fade as it will,
here in the hills a wanderer may stay.

baihua_lines: 空旷的山间刚刚下过一场新雨，
傍晚时分，天气透出阵阵秋意。
皎洁的月光从松林间洒落，
清澈的泉水在山石上淙淙流淌。
竹林中传来喧闹声，是洗衣女子归来了，
莲叶摇动，是渔船正顺流而下。
春日的芳菲就让它随意消歇吧，
山中的秋色自可让游子留居于此。
baihua: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。明月松间照，清泉石上流。竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。

title: 归嵩山作
author: 王维
note: 【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。

en_body: Clear stream flows through a long stretch of grass and reed,
my carriage and horses move slowly, at ease.
The running water seems to hold gentle thoughts,
evening birds return in company together.
A ruined city overlooks the ancient ford,
the setting sun floods all the autumn hills.
Far away at the foot of high Mount Song,
I shall come home and close my gate in peace.

baihua_lines: 清澈的川流映带着绵长的草木丛，
车马从容不迫地缓缓前行。
流水悠悠仿佛怀有无限情意，
傍晚的归禽结伴相随还山。
荒凉的古城紧挨着古老渡口，
落日余晖洒满了秋山。
在遥远的嵩山之下，
归来后我将关上柴门，隐居于此。
baihua: 清川带长薄，车马去闲闲。流水如有意，暮禽相与还。荒城临古渡，落日满秋山。迢递嵩高下，归来且闭关。

my carriage and horses move slowly, at ease.
The running water seems to hold gentle thoughts,
evening birds return in company together.
A ruined city overlooks the ancient ford,
the setting sun floods all the autumn hills.
Far away at the foot of high Mount Song,
I shall come home and close my gate in peace.

title: 杂诗
author: 王维
note: 《杂诗》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【杂诗】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: We met at a corner of Luoyang city long ago,
when I broke a willow branch to send you on your way.
In all the state of Chu no woman matched my beauty,
yet I was a married woman from the land of Qin.
Before others I showed my jade wrists to pass the cup,
by candlelight I loosed my silk gown for my lord.
All who saw my husband riding from the east
said no other man could equal his bearing.
So I say to you, young captain of the guard,
take your jade winepot and trouble me no more.

title: 桃源行
author: 王维
note: 《桃源行》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【桃源行】唐代王维所作的诗。
tr: 漁舟逐水愛山春，兩岸桃花夾去津。坐看紅樹不知遠，行盡青溪不見人。山口潛行始隈隩，山開曠望旋平陸。遙看一處攢雲樹，近入千家散花竹。樵客初傳漢姓名，居人未改秦衣服。居人共住武陵源，還從物外起田園。月明松下房櫳靜，日出雲中雞犬喧。驚聞俗客爭來集，競引還家問都邑。平明閭巷埽花開，薄暮漁樵乘水入。初因避地去人間，及至成仙遂不還。峽裏誰知有人事，世中遙望空雲山。不疑靈境難聞見，塵心未盡思鄉縣。出洞無論隔山水，辭家終擬長游衍。自謂經過舊不迷，安知峰壑今來變。當時只記入山深，青溪幾曲到雲林。春來遍是桃花水，不辨仙源何處尋。

theme: 《桃源行》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代王维的代表性作品之一。
en_body: A fisherman's boat followed the stream, drawn by spring in the hills,
peach blossoms in full bloom lined the ancient ford on both banks.
Gazing at crimson trees he drifted farther and farther on,
until the green stream ended and no person could be seen.
From the mountain mouth he crept, at first through winding hollows,
then the hills opened and level land spread wide before him.
Far off he glimpsed a place where clouds and trees clustered thick,
closer on, a thousand homesteads scattered with flowers and bamboo.
The woodsman spoke for the first time names from the Han dynasty,
the dwellers still wore clothing from the time of Qin.
These people lived together at the Wuling source,
fields and gardens they had raised beyond the world of men.
In moonlight beneath the pines their windows were still and quiet,
at sunrise cocks crowed and dogs barked among the clouds.
Startled to hear of a worldly guest they gathered around,
competing to invite him home and ask of their old towns.
At dawn they swept the lanes where fallen blossoms lay,
at dusk fishermen and woodmen came home by the stream.
At first they fled the world to escape war and strife,
and having reached this immortal land they never returned.
Within the gorge who knew of the world of men?
From outside men gazed and saw only clouded hills.
The fisherman did not doubt this realm was hard to find,
yet worldly heart not spent, he longed for his home county.
Once outside the cave, though mountains and rivers barred the way,
he left his family at last, resolved to wander back.
He thought the road he'd traveled he would never lose,
not knowing peaks and valleys had altered in his absence.
He remembered only that he had entered deep in the hills,
following green stream bends to reach the clouded woods.
When spring came, peach-blossom flood was everywhere,
and he could not tell where the immortal source lay hidden.

baihua_lines: 渔船顺着溪水漂流，贪爱着山间的春色，
两岸的桃花夹着古津渡口盛开。
只顾看满树红花，不知不觉划了很远，
划到青溪尽头，竟然看不到一个人影。
从山口蹑足潜行，起初山路幽深曲折，
再往前山势开阔，眼前忽然现出平坦的陆地。
远远望去有一处地方云树聚簇，
走近才发现是散落着花竹的千户人家。
这里的樵客才第一次听说汉朝以来的姓名，
居民们还没有改掉秦朝时的衣着装束。
居民们都一同住在武陵源里，
在尘世之外建起了田园居所。
月明之夜松下的房栊分外寂静，
日出时分云中传来鸡鸣犬吠之声。
听说有俗世客人来了，大家都惊奇地聚集过来，
争相邀请到家中，问起故乡城邑的消息。
清早街巷里人们扫开落花出门劳作，
傍晚打鱼砍柴的人们乘船顺水归来。
当初他们为了躲避战乱才离开人间，
等到成了仙境便再也不回还。
这峡谷之中哪里知道人世间的事，
外面的人遥望这里只能看见空茫云山。
渔夫并不怀疑这仙境难以闻见，
只是尘心未尽，思念起故乡县城。
出洞之后无论隔着多少山水，
他终究还是辞别家人打算再次远游寻访。
自以为经过的旧路不会迷路，
哪里知道峰峦沟壑如今已经改变。
当时只记得进入山中很深，
青溪拐了几道弯才到达云林深处。
春天来了，遍地都是桃花汛水，
再也辨不清仙源该往何处寻觅。

title: 汉江临眺
author: 王维

en_body: The Chu frontier meets the waters of Three Xiang,
Jingmen opens onto the nine river branches.
The river flows beyond the bounds of heaven and earth,
the mountain hues are seen and unseen between the haze.
Cities seem to float upon the forward reach,
waves heave and stir the far-off sky.
Xiangyang basks in fair wind and lovely weather,
let me stay and drink with old Master Shan.

title: 洛阳女儿行
author: 王维
note: 《洛阳女儿行》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【洛阳女儿行】唐代王维所作的诗。

en_body: A girl of Luoyang lives just across from my door,
her face still young — she can be little more than fifteen.
Her husband rides a dapple horse with jade-studded reins,
her maid bears sliced carp on a golden plate.
Painted towers and crimson pavilions face each other in rows,
red peach and green willow hang below the eaves.
Behind silk curtains she's led to a seven-fragrance coach,
jeweled fans welcome her home to a nine-flowered canopy.
Her wanton lord is rich and proud in his youth,
more arrogant in luxury than Shi Chong of old.
He dotes on his Jasper Girl, teaching her to dance himself,
and gives away coral trees without a second thought.
By the spring window the nine-flame lamp dies at dawn,
its petal-cinders fluttering like scattered flowers.
After play there is no time to practice a tune,
when dressed and painted she only sits by the incense.
All her acquaintances in the city are wealthy and grand,
day and night she visits the great mansions of Zhao and Li.
But who pities the Yue girl with a face like jade,
poor and humble, washing silk by the riverside alone?

baihua_lines: 洛阳有位女儿就住在我家对门，
看容颜才十五岁多一点的年纪。
丈夫骑着配有玉勒的青骢马，
侍女用金盘端上细切的鲤鱼脍。
画阁朱楼鳞次栉比，遥遥相望，
红桃绿柳的枝条垂向檐前。
罗帐之中被送上七香车，
宝扇遮面迎回九华帐中。
她的丈夫青春年少就富贵双全，
意气骄奢比石季伦还要奢侈。
他怜爱这位碧玉般的娇妻亲自教她跳舞，
甚至不惜将珊瑚树随手赠人。
春窗之前九微灯火到天亮才熄灭，
九微灯的片片落花般碎屑飞散。
嬉戏完了竟没有练习曲子的时间，
梳妆好了就只是坐着薰香。
城中相识的尽是繁华富贵人家，
日夜往来的都是赵、李那样的贵戚。
有谁怜爱那容颜如玉的越地浣纱女，
她出身贫贱，正在江头独自浣纱呢。

en_body: The slanting sun shines on the village hamlet,
along deep lanes the cattle and sheep are coming home.
An old man waits for his herdboy grandson,
leaning on his staff by the thornwood gate.
Pheasants call in the wheatfields where the grain is in ear,
silkworms sleep as mulberry leaves grow thin.
Plowmen return with hoes slung over their shoulders,
meeting each other they chat and linger long.
Seeing this, I envy the ease of country life,
and sighing, I chant the Shi Wei — homeward is my thought.

en_lines: The autumn moon is new, the autumn dew is light,
her thin silk robe feels chill but she will not change.
Late into the night she plucks her silver zither tenderly,
fearing the empty room, she cannot bear to return.

they steam goosefoot and cook millet, bearing meals to the eastern fields.
Across misty flooded paddies the white egrets fly,
in the shade of summer trees the orioles sing.
In mountain stillness I meditate on morning hibiscus blooms,
beneath pines I pick sun-mallow for my vegetarian meal.
I have cast aside all social forms like an old rustic,
why should the seagulls still mistrust me now?

回首眺望金陵江岸，
依恋不舍地迎着北风北望。

en_body: In middle years I grew to love the Way,
in later life I made my home by Southern Mountain's edge.
When fancy strikes I often wander off alone,
and the joys I find are mine alone to know.
I walk until the stream runs to its end,
then sit and watch the clouds rise from the peaks.
By chance I meet an old woodsman in the forest,
we laugh and talk, and I forget to go back home.

baihua_lines: 中年以后我很喜爱佛道之理，
晚年把家安在终南山边。
兴致来了常常独自出游，
其中的快意美事只有我自己知道。
有时走到流水的尽头，
便坐下来看白云从山间升起。
偶然遇到林中的老人，
就与他谈笑风生，忘了回家的时间。
baihua: 中岁颇好道，晚家南山陲。兴来每独往，胜事空自知。行到水穷处，坐看云起时。偶然值林叟，谈笑无还期。
en_lines: In middle years I grew to love the Way,
in later life I made my home by Southern Mountain's edge.
When fancy strikes I often wander off alone,
and the joys I find are mine alone to know.
I walk until the stream runs to its end,
then sit and watch the clouds rise from the peaks.
By chance I meet an old woodsman in the forest,
we laugh and talk, and I forget to go back home.

en_body: Taiyi Peak rises close to the Heavenly Capital,
range after range stretching to the sea's far edge.
Looking back, white clouds close behind me in a mass,

From the central peak the earthly divisions shift,
a thousand valleys change between shadow and sun.
Seeking a place to spend the night among men,
I call across the water to a woodcutter for direction.

title: 老将行
author: 王维
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。
【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
tr: 少年十五二十時，步行奪得胡馬射。射殺中山白額虎，肯數鄴下黃鬚兒。一身轉戰三千里，一劒曾當百萬師。漢兵奮迅如霹靂，虜騎崩騰畏蒺藜。衞青不敗由天幸，李廣無功緣數奇。自從棄置便衰朽，世事磋跎成白首。昔時飛箭無全目，今日垂楊生左肘。路傍時賣故侯瓜，門前學種先生柳。蒼茫古木連窮巷，寥落寒山對虛牖。誓令疏勒出飛泉，不似潁川空使酒。賀蘭山下陣如雲，羽檄交馳日夕聞。節使三河募年少，詔書五道出將軍。試拂鐵衣如雪色，聊持寶劒動星文。願得燕弓射天將，恥令越甲鳴吳軍。莫嫌舊日雲中守，猶堪一戰取功勳。

en_body: When I was young, fifteen or twenty years old,
I could seize a Tartar horse on foot and shoot its rider.
I slew the white-browed tiger in the mountains,
never yielding to the yellow-whiskered brave of Ye.
Alone I fought across three thousand li of battles,
with one sword I once held back a million foes.
Han soldiers charged swift as lightning and thunder,
enemy horsemen scattered, spiked barriers feared.
Wei Qing won his victories through fortune's favor,
Li Guang gained no title — fate was unkind to him.
Since cast aside, I have withered and grown weak,
the years slip by; my hair has turned white.
Once my arrows could pierce a bird's eye mid-flight,
now my left arm is crippled as if by a weeping willow tumor.
By the roadside I sometimes sell melons like the Marquis of Dongling,
before my gate I plant five willows after Tao Qian.
Gray ancient trees lead to a lonely lane,
bleak cold hills face my empty window.
I vowed like Geng Gong to make Feiquan spring forth at Shule,
not like Guan Fu of Yingchuan venting rage in wine.
Beneath Helan Mountains the battle formations mass like clouds,
feathered dispatches race day and night without cease.
Commissioners levy youths from the Three River lands,
imperial edicts send five columns of generals forth.
I brush my iron armor until it shines like snow,
and grasp my sword whose blade bears star-like patterns.
I long for a Yan bow to shoot the enemy's generals,
shamed that Yue arms should draw near our Wu court.
Do not scorn the old governor of Yunzhong of former days;
he can still fight one more battle and win glory for his lord.

baihua_lines: 十五到二十岁的少年时代，
步行就能夺取胡人的战马射敌骑。
曾射杀过山中的白额猛虎，
武艺岂肯输给邺下的黄须儿曹彰。
一身转战南北，驰骋三千里，
一剑曾抵挡过敌军的百万雄师。
汉军奋迅出击如雷霆霹雳，
敌骑奔逃溃散，畏惧铁蒺藜。
卫青不败乃是由于天幸，
李广未能封侯只因命运数奇。
自从被弃置不用便日渐衰朽，
世事蹉跎，转眼已白发苍苍。
昔日飞箭术精，能射中小鸟一目，
如今久不习武，手臂上好像长了瘤子生了垂杨之疾。
路旁时而学东陵侯种瓜卖瓜，
门前学陶渊明种起了五柳。
苍茫的古树连接着偏僻的陋巷，
寥落的寒山对着空荡荡的窗牖。
发誓要像耿恭那样让疏勒城涌出飞泉，
绝不学颍川灌夫那样借酒使气。
贺兰山下战阵如云密布，
紧急军书日夜往来传送。
节度使从三河地区招募青年从军，
皇帝下诏派五路将军出师征讨。
老将拂拭铁甲，使之亮白如雪色，
姑且挥动宝剑，剑光闪动如星文。
愿得燕地良弓射杀敌国大将，
耻于让越甲兵逼近、惊动吴军朝廷。
莫嫌旧日云中守魏尚已老，
他仍能为国一战，建立功勋。

note: 《西施咏》是王维的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【西施咏】唐代王维所作的诗。
tr: 豔色天下重，西施寧久微。朝仍越溪女，暮作吳宮妃。賤日豈殊衆，貴來方悟稀。邀人傅香粉，不自著羅衣。君寵益嬌態，君憐無是非。當時浣紗伴，莫得同車歸。持謝鄰家子，效顰安可希。

en_body: Great beauty is prized by all the world,
how could Xi Shi remain in low estate for long?
At dawn she was still a washer-girl by Yue Stream,
by evening she was a concubine in the Wu palace.
When poor, she seemed no different from the rest,
in her glory men saw how rare she truly was.
She bids maids apply her scented powder for her,
and never puts on her silk robes herself.
The king's favor makes her yet more winningly coy,
in his doting love all faults are overlooked.
Her old companions who once washed silk with her
may not ride home in the same carriage with her now.
I say to the girls next door who imitate her frown,
borrowed charm will never win a monarch's love.

baihua_lines: 艳丽的姿色为天下人所看重，
西施又怎会长久地微贱下去？
清晨她还是越溪畔的浣纱女子，
傍晚就成了吴宫里的王妃。
微贱时与众人并无不同之处，
尊贵起来才让人悟到她世间稀有。
传唤别人为她敷上香粉，
自己连罗衣也不用亲手穿。
君王的宠爱使她更添娇态，
君王的怜爱让她无是无非。
当时一起浣纱的伙伴，
却不能与她同车一道归来。
奉告邻家那些效颦的女子，
光靠模仿皱眉又怎么能得到宠幸呢？

en_body: The cold hills have turned a deeper green,
autumn waters babble on day by day.
Leaning on my staff outside the thornwood gate,
I listen to evening cicadas in the wind.
Above the ferry lingers the last of the sunset,
from the village a single wisp of smoke rises.
And here comes my friend, drunk like Jieyu of old,
singing wildly before the five willows.

秋水日夜潺潺流淌。
我拄着拐杖站在柴门之外，
临风倾听着傍晚的蝉鸣。
渡头上还留着落日的余晖，
村落里升起一缕缕炊烟。
又遇上像接舆那样的醉汉裴迪，
在五柳前狂歌纵酒。
baihua: 寒山转苍翠，秋水日潺湲。倚杖柴门外，临风听暮蝉。渡头余落日，墟里上孤烟。复值接舆醉，狂歌五柳前。

author: 王维

en_body: I did not know where Xiangji Temple stood,
for several li I walked into cloudy peaks.
Ancient trees — no human path among them,
deep in the mountains a bell rang — whence did it sound?
The spring gurgles, choked by jagged rocks,
sunlight falls coldly upon green pine boughs.
At dusk by the bend of an empty pool,
in meditation I subdue the poison dragon of mind.

baihua_lines: 不知道香积寺在何处，
走入云峰数里仍在寻觅。
古木参天，却没有人行的路径，
深山之中不知从何处传来阵阵钟声。
泉水在嶙峋的危石间幽咽流淌，
日光冷冷地照在青松之上。
暮色时分，空寂的水潭曲折幽深，
在此安禅入定，制服心中的毒龙之妄。
baihua: 不知香积寺，数里入云峰。古木无人迳，深山何处钟。泉声咽危石，日色冷青松。薄暮空潭曲，安禅制毒龙。
en_lines: I did not know where Xiangji Temple stood,
for several li I walked into cloudy peaks.
Ancient trees — no human path among them,
deep in the mountains a bell rang — whence did it sound?
The spring gurgles, choked by jagged rocks,
sunlight falls coldly upon green pine boughs.
At dusk by the bend of an empty pool,
in meditation I subdue the poison dragon of mind.

across a thousand hills cuckoos call and cry.
In the mountains one night of steady rain,
and from each treetop a hundred springs seem to cascade.
Han women pay tribute in tong-cloth,
Ba people dispute their taro fields in court.
Like Wen Weng of old may you renew learning and teaching,
not rest on the deeds of worthies who came before.

title: 送綦毋潜落第还乡
author: 王维
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。

en_body: In this sagely age none remains in seclusion,
all souls of worth have come to serve the throne.
Thus even the hermit of Eastern Mountain
could not remain at ease, gathering ferns to eat.
Having reached the capital, you found the palace gates far,
yet who shall say our cause is not just?
You passed Cold Food Festival by the Yangtze and Huai,
and sewed spring garments in the capital of Luoyang.
I set wine before you on the long road out,
my kindred spirit must now part from me.
Soon you will sail in your cinnamon-oared boat,
before long you will brush your own thornwood gate.
Distant trees seem to travel along with the departing guest,
a lonely village faces the last sunlight.
Our counsel merely chanced to go unheeded this time;
do not say that true friends who understand are few.

baihua_lines: 圣明的时代没有隐居不仕的人，
英才俊杰都来归顺朝廷。
于是便让像东山谢安那样的隐士，
不能再安心隐居、采薇而食了。
到了京城之后，才感觉君门遥远，
谁能说我们的道义不对呢？
在江淮之间度过了寒食佳节，
在京洛之地缝制起春天的衣衫。
在长安大道旁设下酒筵为你送行，
志同道合的友人就要与我分别了。
你将要乘着桂木船泛舟还乡，
不久就能回到家中拂拭荆扉。
远方的树影仿佛带着远行的客人，
孤独的村庄正对着落日余晖。
这次落第只是因为我们的谋划恰好不被采用，
不要以为知音稀少而沮丧。
baihua: 圣代无隐者，英灵尽来归。遂令东山客，不得顾采薇。既至君门远，孰云吾道非。江淮度寒食，京洛缝春衣。置酒临长道，同心与我违。行当浮桂櫂，未几拂荆扉。远树带行客，孤村当落晖。吾谋适不用，勿谓知音稀。
en_lines: In this sagely age none remains in seclusion,
all souls of worth have come to serve the throne.
Thus even the hermit of Eastern Mountain
could not remain at ease, gathering ferns to eat.
Having reached the capital, you found the palace gates far,
yet who shall say our cause is not just?
You passed Cold Food Festival by the Yangtze and Huai,
and sewed spring garments in the capital of Luoyang.
I set wine before you on the long road out,
my kindred spirit must now part from me.
Soon you will sail in your cinnamon-oared boat,
before long you will brush your own thornwood gate.
Distant trees seem to travel along with the departing guest,
a lonely village faces the last sunlight.
Our counsel merely chanced to go unheeded this time;
do not say that true friends who understand are few.

en_body: In my later years I care only for quiet,
the ten thousand affairs no longer touch my heart.
I examine myself and find no grand strategy,
knowing only to return to my old woods.
Pine wind blows as I loosen my robe in ease,
the mountain moon shines as I play my lute.
You ask the truth of failure and success?
A fisherman's song drifts deep into the cove.

en_body: High gates and lofty pavilions bask in the afterglow,
peach and plum cast deep shade, willow catkins fly.
Palace bells ring sparse as evening comes to the offices,
birds sing in the chancellery, clerks are few and far between.
At dawn your jade pendants sway as you hasten to the golden hall,
at dusk you bear imperial edicts, bowing at the palace gate.
I would gladly follow you, but age weighs heavily upon me,
and I must lay aside court robes to nurse my illness.

en_body: Men say that Qingxi once had nine winding bends,
yet only one remains today.
By the Jiang family mansion it has become a flower garden,
before the Eastern Prefect's gate it is a vegetable plot.
Climb the tower and you may still gaze at layered peaks,
floating in a boat you may still drink wine in bliss.
I suppose in those days all was well and intact,
Tiaozha and Xiaoxiang themselves would not have surpassed it.

如今只剩下一曲还依稀可见。
江家宅子旁已经变成了花圃，
东府门前已被开垦作菜园。
登上楼阁自然还能观赏层叠的山嶂，
泛舟溪上仍然可以醉饮美酒。
想来当年这些地方都完好无恙，
苕霅、潇湘那样的胜景也不足称道了。
baihua: 人道青溪有九曲，如今一曲仅能存。江家宅畔成花圃，东府门前作菜园。登阁自堪观叠嶂，泛舟犹可醉芳樽。料应当日皆无恙，苕霅潇湘不足言。
en_lines: Men say that Qingxi once had nine winding bends,
yet only one remains today.
By the Jiang family mansion it has become a flower garden,
before the Eastern Prefect's gate it is a vegetable plot.
Climb the tower and you may still gaze at layered peaks,
floating in a boat you may still drink wine in bliss.
I suppose in those days all was well and intact,
Tiaozha and Xiaoxiang themselves would not have surpassed it.

title: 卖炭翁
author: 白居易
note: 《卖炭翁》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【卖炭翁】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 卖炭翁，伐薪烧炭南山中。满面尘灰烟火色，两鬓苍苍十指黑。卖炭得钱何所营，身上衣裳口中食。可怜身上衣正单，心忧炭贱愿天寒。夜来城外一尺雪，晓驾炭车辗冰辙。牛困人饥日已高，市南门外泥中歇。翩翩两骑来是谁？黄衣使者白衫儿。手把文书口称敕，回车叱牛牵向北。一车炭，千余斤，宫使驱将惜不得。半匹红纱一丈绫，系向牛头充炭值。

en_body: An old charcoal seller,
who cuts firewood and burns charcoal in the Southern Hills.
His face is covered with dust, the color of smoke and ash,
his temples streaked with gray, his ten fingers blackened through.
What does he do with the money from selling charcoal?
It buys the clothes upon his back and food to put in his mouth.
Pity him — in the thin clothes he wears,
he fears the charcoal price is low and hopes the cold will worsen.
A foot of snow fell outside the city overnight,
at dawn he drives his cart over frozen ruts.
The ox is tired, the man is hungry, the sun is high,
when he rests in the mud outside the south market gate.
Two riders come cantering up — who might they be?
Yellow-robed palace eunuchs and their white-shirted attendants.
Documents in hand, they declare it is the emperor's decree,
turn the cart about, shout at the ox, and lead it northward.
A cartload of charcoal,
more than a thousand catties in weight,
the palace men drive it off — he grieves but cannot stop them.
Half a bolt of red gauze and a bolt of thin damask,
tied to the ox's head, they claim is payment for the charcoal.

在终南山里砍柴烧炭。
满面灰尘，一脸被烟火熏烤的颜色，
两鬓头发斑白，十个手指都是乌黑的。
卖炭得来的钱用来做什么呢？
只是为了身上穿的衣裳和嘴里吃的食物。
可怜他身上正穿着单薄的衣衫，
却担心炭价太低，心里盼望天气再寒冷一些。
夜里城外下了一尺厚的大雪，
清晨他驾着炭车轧着冰冻的车辙赶路。
牛累了，人也饿了，太阳已经升得很高，
才在集市南门外的泥泞中歇息。
两个骑马翩翩而来的人是谁？
是穿黄衣的宫使和穿白衫的爪牙。
他们手里拿着文书，口称是皇帝的命令，
掉转车头，吆喝着牛，把车向北牵去。
一车炭，
有一千多斤重，
宫使们强行赶走，老翁百般不舍却也无可奈何。
他们把半匹红纱和一丈绫，
往牛头上一挂，就充当了炭的价钱。
baihua: 卖炭翁，伐薪烧炭南山中。满面尘灰烟火色，两鬓苍苍十指黑。卖炭得钱何所营，身上衣裳口中食。可怜身上衣正单，心忧炭贱愿天寒。夜来城外一尺雪，晓驾炭车辗冰辙。牛困人饥日已高，市南门外泥中歇。翩翩两骑来是谁？黄衣使者白衫儿。手把文书口称敕，回车叱牛牵向北。一车炭，千余斤，宫使驱将惜不得。半匹红纱一丈绫，系向牛头充炭值。
en_lines: An old charcoal seller,
who cuts firewood and burns charcoal in the Southern Hills.
His face is covered with dust, the color of smoke and ash,
his temples streaked with gray, his ten fingers blackened through.
What does he do with the money from selling charcoal?
It buys the clothes upon his back and food to put in his mouth.
Pity him — in the thin clothes he wears,
he fears the charcoal price is low and hopes the cold will worsen.
A foot of snow fell outside the city overnight,
at dawn he drives his cart over frozen ruts.
The ox is tired, the man is hungry, the sun is high,
when he rests in the mud outside the south market gate.
Two riders come cantering up — who might they be?
Yellow-robed palace eunuchs and their white-shirted attendants.
Documents in hand, they declare it is the emperor's decree,
turn the cart about, shout at the ox, and lead it northward.
One now here there still yet still.
more than a thousand catties in weight,
the palace men drive it off — he grieves but cannot stop them.
Half a bolt of red gauze and a bolt of thin damask,
tied to the ox's head, they claim is payment for the charcoal.

title: 后宫词
author: 白居易
note: 《后宫词》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【后宫词】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 淚濕羅巾夢不成，夜深前殿按歌聲。紅顏未老恩先斷，斜倚薰籠坐到明。
appr: 《后宫词》是唐代白居易所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「泪湿罗巾梦不成，」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《后宫词》历代传诵不衰，是白居易诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: Tears dampen her silk scarf — dreams will not come,
deep in the night, singing beats drift from the front hall.
Her rosy beauty has not faded yet favor is cut off already,
leaning on the incense cage she sits alone until dawn.

title: 琵琶行
author: 白居易
body: 未若此调呦呦兮啁啁，嘈嘈兮啾啾。
note: 【兮】楚辞及古诗常见语气词，相当于"啊"，用于舒缓节奏、增强咏叹意味。
【青山】青翠的山峦，常象征永恒、宁静与归隐。
【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
tr: 何人斸得一片木，三尺春冰五音足。一彈決破真珠囊，迸落金盤聲斷續。飄飄颻颻寒丁丁，蟲豸出蟄神鬼驚。秋鴻叫侶代雲黑，猩猩夜啼蠻月明。潏潏汩汩聲不定，胡雛學漢語未正。若似長安月蝕時，滿城敲鼓聲噒噒。青山飛起不壓物，野水流來欲濕人。傷人憶得陳後主，春殿半酣細腰舞。黃鶯百舌正相呼，玉樹後庭花帶雨。二妃哭處山重重，二妃沒後雲溶溶。夜深霜露鎖空廟，零落一叢斑竹風。金谷園中草初綠，石崇一弄思歸曲。當時二十四友人，手把金杯聽不足。又似賈客蜀道間，千鐸萬磬鳴空山。未若此調呦呦啊，啁啁，嘈嘈啊，啾啾。引之於山，獸不能走。吹之於水，魚不能游。方知此藝不可有，人間萬事憑雙手。若何爲我再三彈，送却花前一尊酒。

baihua_lines: 是什么人砍来这样一块木料，
三尺长的琴身像春冰般透亮，五音齐备。
手指一拨，弹破了珍珠的囊袋，
珍珠滚落金盘，声音时断时续。
琴声飘飘荡荡，在寒气中叮咚作响，
蛰伏的虫子被惊醒，神鬼也为之惊叹。
秋雁在黑沉沉的云层里呼唤伴侣，
猩猩在洒满月光的夜里哀啼。
水声潺潺汩汩，声息不定，
就像西域的孩童学讲汉语，发音还不纯正。
又像长安城发生月蚀的时候，
满城敲起铜锣鼓声，响成一片。
琴声激越时，仿佛青山飞起却不压万物，
又像野水流来，几乎要打湿衣裳。
这令人想起陈后主的悲伤往事，
春殿里他半醉半醒，看细腰女子翩翩起舞。
黄莺和百舌鸟正在枝头相互啼叫，
《玉树后庭花》的乐曲声中带着细雨。
舜的两位妃子哭祭处，青山层层叠叠，
二妃投水之后，白云溶溶飘荡。
夜深了，霜露紧锁着空寂的祠庙，
只有一丛斑竹在风中零落摇响。
金谷园里春草刚刚泛绿的时候，
石崇弹奏了一曲《思归引》。
当时在座的二十四位友人，
手把金杯听曲，怎么听都听不够。
又像行商在险峻的蜀道间赶路，
千声万声的铃铎磬音在空山中回荡。
都比不上这曲调呦呦婉转、啁啁细碎、嘈嘈急切、啾啾清脆。
把这琴声引到山间，
野兽都听得停下脚步，忘了奔走。
把这琴声吹到水上，
游鱼都听得停在水里，忘了游动。
这才知道这样绝妙的技艺世间罕有，
人间万般事情，都要靠双手来创造。
为何不为我再弹奏一曲？
好让我在花前饮尽这一杯酒。
baihua: 何人𣃁得一片木，三尺春冰五音足。一弹决破真珠囊，迸落金盘声断续。飘飘飖飖寒丁丁，虫豸出蛰神鬼惊。秋鸿叫侣代云黑，猩猩夜啼蛮月明。潏潏汩汩声不定，胡雏学汉语未正。若似长安月蚀时，满城敲鼓声噒噒。青山飞起不压物，野水流来欲湿人。伤人忆得陈后主，春殿半酣细腰舞。黄莺百舌正相呼，玉树后庭花带雨。二妃哭处山重重，二妃没后云溶溶。夜深霜露锁空庙，零落一丛斑竹风。金谷园中草初绿，石崇一弄思归曲。当时二十四友人，手把金杯听不足。又似贾客蜀道间，千铎万磬鸣空山。未若此调呦呦啊，啁啁，嘈嘈啊，啾啾。引之于山，兽不能走。吹之于水，鱼不能游。方知此艺不可有，人间万事凭双手。若何为我再三弹，送却花前一尊酒。
en_lines: Who carved this single piece of fine wood,
Three feet long like spring ice, the five notes complete.
One pluck bursts the pouch of pearls,
They spill onto golden plates, the sound broken yet sustained.
Drifting, floating, cold notes tinkle clear,
Hibernating insects awaken, spirits and ghosts startle.
Autumn geese call their mates through darkening clouds,
Orangutans cry at night beneath the southern moon.
Gurgling, bubbling, the sound flows unsteady,
Like a Tartar child learning Chinese, the tones not yet right.
It resembles the moon eclipse over Chang'an,
When drums and gongs resound throughout the city.
Green mountains seem to fly up yet crush nothing,
Wild waters flow forward, about to drench the listener.
With aching heart I think of Chen the Last Ruler,
In spring halls half-drunk, watching slim-waisted dancers.
Orioles and mockingbirds call to one another,
As "Jade Tree and Backyard Flowers" drifts through rain.
Where the two imperial consorts wept, mountains pile on mountains,
After they perished, clouds drift soft and heavy.
Deep at night frost and dew lock the empty shrine,
While a clump of spotted bamboo sways in the wind.
When grass first turned green in the Golden Valley Garden,
Shi Chong played once more the Song of Longing for Home.
The twenty-four friends who gathered there that day,
Held golden cups and never tired of listening.
Again it sounds like merchants on the treacherous Shu roads,
A thousand bells and chimes ringing through empty mountains.
Yet none match this tune—yoo-yoo, chirp-chirp, loud and clear, twittering soft.
Play this melody among the mountains,
And beasts forget to run, spellbound.
Blow this melody over the waters,
And fish forget to swim, entranced.
Only then do I know such art is beyond compare,
All things on earth are wrought by human hands.
Oh play it once more, I beg you, for my sake,
As I drain this cup of wine before the flowers.

title: 自河南经乱关内阻饥兄弟离散
author: 白居易
note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。

en_title: 自河南经乱关内阻饥兄弟离散
baihua_lines: 战乱灾荒之年，祖传的家业荡然一空，
兄弟们漂泊异乡，各自东西离散。
战乱过后，田园一片荒芜冷落，
骨肉亲人流离失所，奔波在道路之上。
顾影自怜，我们像分飞千里的孤雁，
又像辞别根株、在深秋里飘散的蓬草。
共望天上的明月，我们应该都在垂泪吧，
这一夜里，五处地方的思乡之心都是一样的。
baihua: 时难年饥世业空，弟兄羇旅各西东。田园寥落干戈后，骨肉流离道路中。吊影分为千里鴈，辞根散作九秋蓬。共看明月应垂泪，一夜乡心五处同。
en_lines: In war and famine, our ancestral estate lies desolate,
Brothers wander as strangers, scattered east and west.
Fields and gardens lie waste after the clash of arms,
Flesh and blood drift homeless along the roads.
Gazing at our shadows, we are wild geese parted a thousand li,
Torn from our roots, scattered like tumbleweed in late autumn.
Gazing together at the bright moon, we must all shed tears,
This single night, five hearts ache for home as one.

title: 赋得古原草送别
author: 白居易
note: 《赋得古原草送别》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【赋得古原草送别】唐代白居易所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 古原上的野草长得多么茂盛，
一年一度枯萎，又一度繁荣。
野火怎么烧也烧不尽它，
春风一吹，它又重新生长起来。
芳草的幽香蔓延到远方的古道，
阳光下的翠绿连接着荒凉的城池。
又在这里送别远行的友人，
萋萋芳草满含着离别的深情。
baihua: 离离原上草，一岁一枯荣。野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。远芳侵古道，晴翠接荒城。又送王孙去，萋萋满别情。
en_lines: Lush, lush the grass upon the ancient plain,
Each year it withers, then flourishes again.
Wildfire cannot burn it all away,
Spring winds blow and it springs up once more.
Distant fragrance steals across the old road,
Sunlit emerald meets the ruined city walls.
Once more I see my noble friend depart,
Thick, thick the grass o'erflows with parting grief.

author: 白居易
note: 《长恨歌》是白居易的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【长恨歌】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 漢皇重色思傾國，御宇多年求不得。楊家有女初長成，養在深閨人未識。天生麗質難自棄，一朝選在君王側。回眸一笑百媚生，六宮粉黛無顏色。春寒賜浴華清池，溫泉水滑洗凝脂。侍兒扶起嬌無力，始是新承恩澤時。雲鬢花顏金步搖，芙蓉帳暖度春宵。春宵苦短日高起，從此君王不早朝。承歡侍宴無閑暇，春從春遊夜專夜。後宮佳麗三千人，三千寵愛在一身。金屋妝成嬌侍夜，玉樓宴罷醉和春。姊妹弟兄皆列土，可憐光彩生門戶。遂令天下父母心，不重生男重生女。驪宮高處入青雲，仙樂風飄處處聞。緩歌慢舞凝絲竹，盡日君王看不足。漁陽鞞鼓動地來，驚破霓裳羽衣曲。九重城闕煙塵生，千乘萬騎西南行。翠華搖搖行復止，西出都門百餘里。六軍不發無奈何，宛轉蛾眉馬前死。花鈿委地無人收，翠翹金雀玉搔頭。君王掩面救不得，回看血淚相和流。黃埃散漫風蕭索，雲棧縈紆登劒閣。峨嵋山下少人行，旌旗無光日色薄。蜀江水碧蜀山青，聖主朝朝暮暮情。行宮見月傷心色，夜雨聞鈴腸斷聲。天旋日轉迴龍馭，到此躊躇不能去。馬嵬坡下泥土中，不見玉顏空死處。君臣相顧盡霑衣，東望都門信馬歸。歸來池苑皆依舊，太液芙蓉未央柳。芙蓉如面柳如眉，對此如何不淚垂？春風桃李花開夜，秋雨梧桐葉落時。西宮南苑多秋草，宮葉滿階紅不埽。棃園弟子白髮新，椒房阿監青娥老。夕殿螢飛思悄然，孤燈挑盡未成眠。遲遲鐘鼓初長夜，耿耿星河欲曙天。鴛鴦瓦冷霜華重，翡翠衾寒誰與共。悠悠生死別經年，魂魄不曾來入夢。臨邛道士鴻都客，能以精誠致魂魄。爲感君王展轉思，遂教方士殷勤覓。排空馭氣奔如電，升天入地求之徧。上窮碧落下黃泉，兩處茫茫皆不見。忽聞海上有仙山，山在虛無縹緲間。樓閣玲瓏五雲起，其中綽約多仙子。中有一人字太真，雪膚花貌參差是。金闕西廂叩玉扃，轉教小玉報雙成。聞道漢家天子使，九華帳裏夢魂驚。攬衣推枕起裴回，珠箔銀屏邐迤開。雲鬢半偏新睡覺，花冠不整下堂來。風吹仙袂飄颻舉，猶似霓裳羽衣舞。玉容寂莫淚闌干，棃花一枝春帶雨。含情凝睇謝君王，一別音容兩渺茫。昭陽殿裏恩愛絕，蓬萊宮中日月長。回頭下望人寰處，不見長安見塵霧。唯將舊物表深情，鈿合金釵寄將去。釵留一股合一扇，釵擘黃金合分鈿。但教心似金鈿堅，天上人間會相見。臨別殷勤重寄詞，詞中有誓兩心知。七月七日長生殿，夜半無人私語時。在天願作比翼鳥，在地願爲連理枝。天長地久有時盡，此恨緜緜無絕期。
appr: 《长恨歌》是唐代白居易所作的诗名篇。全诗共120句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《长恨歌》历代传诵不衰，是白居易诗歌风格的集中体现。
st:
【起·开篇】前30句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第31至60句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第61至90句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末30句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。
img:
【月】月亮意象，常寄托思乡、怀人、孤寂之意，亦象征高洁、永恒。

【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【水】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【雨】雨意象，春雨喜，秋雨愁，夜雨乡思，暮雨离愁。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
bg: 《长恨歌》为唐代白居易所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者白居易在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《长恨歌》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代白居易的代表性作品之一。

appreciation: 《长恨歌》是唐代白居易所作的诗名篇。全诗共120句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《长恨歌》历代传诵不衰，是白居易诗歌风格的集中体现。
structure:
【起·开篇】前30句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第31至60句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第61至90句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末30句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。
imagery:
【月】月亮意象，常寄托思乡、怀人、孤寂之意，亦象征高洁、永恒。

【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

【山】山峦意象，常象征巍峨、永恒、隐逸、阻隔。

【水】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【雨】雨意象，春雨喜，秋雨愁，夜雨乡思，暮雨离愁。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
background: 《长恨歌》为唐代白居易所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者白居易在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。

baihua_lines: 唐明皇爱好女色，一心想要得到倾国倾城的美人，
即位多年，却一直没能找到合意的佳人。
杨家有位女儿刚刚长大成人，
养在深闺之中，外人都不知道她的美貌。
她天生丽质，终究不会被埋没，
终于有一天被选到了皇帝的身边。
她回头嫣然一笑，生出百般妩媚，
六宫的粉白黛绿顿时都黯然失色。
春寒料峭时，皇帝赐她在华清池沐浴，
温泉的水滑润如脂，洗濯着她凝脂般的肌肤。
侍女扶她起来时，她娇柔无力，
这正是她刚刚得到皇帝恩宠的时候。
鬓发如云、容颜似花，金步摇在发间轻轻颤动，
温暖的芙蓉帐里，他们欢度着春宵。
只恨春宵太短，一觉睡到太阳高高升起，
从此以后皇帝再也不上早朝了。
她承欢侍宴，没有一点闲暇时间，
春天随从春游，夜晚也是她独占君王。
后宫里有三千个美丽的女子，
皇帝对三千人的宠爱都集中在她一人身上。
金屋中梳妆打扮，夜夜撒娇侍奉君王，
玉楼上酒酣宴罢，醉意中掺着春意。
兄弟姐妹都因她而封侯拜相，
杨家门户生辉，令人羡慕不已。
于是使得天下做父母的人心里，
都不重视生男孩，反而看重生女孩了。
骊山上的华清宫高耸入云，
仙乐随风飘散，处处都能听到。
轻歌曼舞，和着丝竹乐器的旋律，
君王整天看也看不够。
渔阳的战鼓惊天动地地传来，
惊断了《霓裳羽衣曲》的舞步歌声。
九重宫殿里扬起了滚滚烟尘，
千乘万骑护卫着皇帝向西南逃去。
皇家的旌旗摇摇颤颤，走了又停，
西出长安城门才走了一百多里路。
六军不肯前进，皇帝也无可奈何，
绝代美人杨贵妃最终被缢死在马前。
她头上的花钿丢在地上，没有人去收，
还有翠翘、金雀、玉搔头这些首饰。
君王掩着脸，想救却救不了她，
回头看去，血泪交混着往下流。
黄尘漫漫，秋风萧瑟凄凉，
栈道高入云端，蜿蜒曲折地登上剑阁。
峨嵋山下路上行人稀少，
旌旗黯淡无光，日光也显得惨淡。
蜀地的江水碧绿，蜀山青翠，
圣明的君王朝朝暮暮都在思念她。
行宫里望见月亮，也是令人伤心的颜色，
夜雨中听到铃响，更是肝肠寸断的声音。
时局好转，皇帝车驾返回京城，
到了杨贵妃自尽的地方，徘徊着不忍离去。
马嵬坡下的泥土之中，
再也见不到她如玉的容颜，只有她死去的地方空留着。
君臣互相看着，眼泪都沾湿了衣裳，
向东望着都门，任由马儿自己走回去。
回来一看，池苑园林依旧如从前，
太液池的荷花还在，未央宫的杨柳依旧。
荷花像她的脸，柳叶像她的眉，
面对此情此景，怎么能不落泪呢？
春风吹开桃李花的夜晚，
秋雨打落梧桐叶的时节。
西宫和南内长满了秋草，
红叶落满台阶，也没有人打扫。
梨园的弟子们头上新添了白发，
椒房的女官和宫女们也都衰老了。
夜晚宫殿里萤火虫飞过，思绪悄然伤感，
孤灯的灯草挑尽了，还是难以入眠。
钟鼓声缓缓响起，漫长的黑夜才刚开始，
银河渐渐发亮，天就要亮了。
鸳鸯瓦上结了厚厚的霜花，冷冰冰的，
翡翠被里寒气袭人，还有谁与君王共眠？
生离死别悠悠已经过了一年，
她的魂魄却从来不曾来到君王的梦中。
有一位临邛来的道士，在京城作客，
他能用精诚招来死者的魂魄。
被君王辗转反侧的思念所感动，
于是让方士去殷勤地寻觅她的魂魄。
方士腾云驾雾，像闪电一样飞驰，
升天入地，到处都找遍了。
上面找遍了青天，下面找遍了黄泉，
两个地方都茫茫不见她的踪影。
忽然听说海上有一座仙山，
那山坐落在虚无缥缈之间。
玲珑的楼阁耸立在五彩祥云之中，
里面有许多风姿绰约的仙女。
其中有一位仙女名叫太真，
雪白的肌肤、如花的容貌，好像就是她。
方士来到金阙西边，敲开玉石的院门，
请小玉转告双成，说天子的使者来了。
听说汉家天子派来了使者，
九华帐里的她从梦中惊醒。
她披上衣服、推开枕头，起身徘徊，
珠帘和银屏一层层地打开。
她云鬓半偏，刚刚睡醒，
花冠都没来得及整理，就走下堂来。
风吹着她的仙衣袖袂飘飘飞舞，
还像当年跳《霓裳羽衣舞》时的模样。
她寂寞的玉容上泪痕纵横，
像一枝春天的梨花带着雨水。
她含情凝视，请使者转告君王，
自从分别以后，声音和容貌都渺茫难见了。
昭阳殿里的恩爱已经断绝，
蓬莱宫中的岁月漫长无尽。
她回头向下遥望人间世界，
望不见长安，只见弥漫的尘雾。
只能用旧时的信物来表达深情，
把钿盒和金钗请使者捎回去。
金钗留下一股，钿盒留下一扇，
金钗掰开，钿盒分开，各留一半作为纪念。
只要我们的心像金钿一样坚贞，
天上人间总有一天会再相见。
临别时她又殷勤地拜托使者捎话，
话中有誓言，只有两个人心里知道。
那年七月七日在长生殿里，
半夜无人的时候，我们曾私下低语。
在天上，我们愿作双宿双飞的比翼鸟，
在地上，我们愿作枝干相连的连理枝。
天长地久也总会有尽头的时候，
这生死遗恨啊，却永远没有完结的日子。
baihua: 汉皇重色思倾国，御宇多年求不得。杨家有女初长成，养在深闺人未识。天生丽质难自弃，一朝选在君王侧。回眸一笑百媚生，六宫粉黛无颜色。春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂。侍儿扶起娇无力，始是新承恩泽时。云鬓花颜金步摇，芙蓉帐暖度春宵。春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝。承欢侍宴无闲暇，春从春游夜专夜。后宫佳丽三千人，三千宠爱在一身。金屋妆成娇侍夜，玉楼宴罢醉和春。姊妹弟兄皆列土，可怜光彩生门户。遂令天下父母心，不重生男重生女。骊宫高处入青云，仙乐风飘处处闻。缓歌慢舞凝丝竹，尽日君王看不足。渔阳鞞鼓动地来，惊破霓裳羽衣曲。九重城阙烟尘生，千乘万骑西南行。翠华摇摇行复止，西出都门百余里。六军不发无奈何，宛转蛾眉马前死。花钿委地无人收，翠翘金雀玉搔头。君王掩面救不得，回看血泪相和流。黄埃散漫风萧索，云栈萦纡登劒阁。峨嵋山下少人行，旌旗无光日色薄。蜀江水碧蜀山青，圣主朝朝暮暮情。行宫见月伤心色，夜雨闻铃肠断声。天旋日转回龙驭，到此踌躇不能去。马嵬坡下泥土中，不见玉颜空死处。君臣相顾尽沾衣，东望都门信马归。归来池苑皆依旧，太液芙蓉未央柳。芙蓉如面柳如眉，对此如何不泪垂？春风桃李花开夜，秋雨梧桐叶落时。西宫南苑多秋草，宫叶满阶红不埽。棃园弟子白发新，椒房阿监青娥老。夕殿萤飞思悄然，孤灯挑尽未成眠。迟迟钟鼓初长夜，耿耿星河欲曙天。鸳鸯瓦冷霜华重，翡翠衾寒谁与共。悠悠生死别经年，魂魄不曾来入梦。临邛道士鸿都客，能以精诚致魂魄。为感君王展转思，遂教方士殷勤觅。排空驭气奔如电，升天入地求之徧。上穷碧落下黄泉，两处茫茫皆不见。忽闻海上有仙山，山在虚无缥缈间。楼阁玲珑五云起，其中绰约多仙子。中有一人字太真，雪肤花貌参差是。金阙西厢叩玉扃，转教小玉报双成。闻道汉家天子使，九华帐里梦魂惊。揽衣推枕起裴回，珠箔银屏逦迤开。云鬓半偏新睡觉，花冠不整下堂来。风吹仙袂飘飖举，犹似霓裳羽衣舞。玉容寂莫泪阑干，棃花一枝春带雨。含情凝睇谢君王，一别音容两渺茫。昭阳殿里恩爱绝，蓬莱宫中日月长。回头下望人寰处，不见长安见尘雾。唯将旧物表深情，钿合金钗寄将去。钗留一股合一扇，钗擘黄金合分钿。但教心似金钿坚，天上人间会相见。临别殷勤重寄词，词中有誓两心知。七月七日长生殿，夜半无人私语时。在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝。天长地久有时尽，此恨緜緜无绝期。
en_lines: The Han Emperor prized beauty and longed for a nation-toppling charm,
For years on the throne he sought but could not find.
A maiden of the Yang house had just come of age,
Raised in secluded chambers, unknown to the world.
Born with surpassing beauty she could not long remain hidden,
One day she was chosen to attend the sovereign's side.
A single backward glance, a smile, a hundred charms bloomed,
All the painted beauties of the six palaces faded to nothing.
In the chill of spring he granted her bath at Huaqing Pool,
The hot spring waters, smooth and warm, washed her creamy skin.
When maids helped her rise, she was frail and languid,
This was the moment she first received imperial favor.
Cloud-like tresses, flower-like face, a golden swinging hairpin,
Within the warm lotus curtain they spent the spring night.
Too brief the spring night—the sun rose high before they woke,
And from that day the Emperor held no more morning courts.
She attended his pleasures, served his feasts with never a moment free,
She followed him in spring outings, alone shared his nights.
In the rear palace were three thousand fair ladies,
Yet all the love for three thousand was lavished on her alone.
In the Golden Chamber she dressed and waited on him at night,
In the Jade Tower the feast ended, drunk with spring.
Her sisters and brothers all were enfeoffed with lands,
Such glorious light shone upon the Yang family gate.
This caused the hearts of parents throughout the empire,
To prize the birth of daughters more than sons.
High on Li Palace, piercing the blue clouds,
Immortal music drifted on the wind, heard everywhere.
Slow songs, languid dances, strings and flutes held in harmony,
All day long the Emperor never tired of watching.
Then war drums from Yuyang shook the very earth,
Shattering the melody of "Rainbow Skirts and Feather Robes."
Dust and smoke rose from the ninefold city gates,
A thousand chariots, ten thousand horsemen fled southwest.
The imperial banners swayed, halted, then moved on again,
A hundred li west of the capital gates they stopped.
The six armies would not advance—there was no help for it,
The delicate moth-eyebrowed beauty perished before the horses.
Her flower hairpins fell to the ground, no one gathered them,
Kingfisher feathers, golden sparrow pins, jade hair ornaments.
The Emperor covered his face—he could not save her,
Looking back, blood and tears mingled and flowed.
Yellow dust scattered wide, the wind blew desolate,
Cloud-girdled plank paths wound upward to Sword Pavilion.
Beneath Emei Mountains few travelers passed,
Banners and flags lost their luster, the sun grew dim.
The rivers of Shu were emerald, the mountains of Shu were green,
The sacred sovereign's longing endured day after day.
In the traveling palace the moon looked heart-breaking,
The night rain on bells made a sound that broke the heart.
Heaven turned, the days wheeled, the imperial carriage returned,
Arriving at that spot he lingered, unable to leave.
In the earth at the foot of Mawei Slope,
Her jade-like face was gone—only the place of death remained.
Lord and ministers looked at each other, robes soaked with tears,
They gazed east toward the capital and let their horses lead them home.
Returned, the pools and gardens were just as before,
The lotuses of Taiye Lake, the willows of Weiyang Palace.
Lotuses were like her face, willows like her brows,
Facing these, how could tears not fall?
Spring winds, peach and plum blossoms on blooming nights,
Autumn rains, when wutong leaves fell to the ground.
The Western Palace and Southern Court were overgrown with autumn grass,
Red leaves covered the steps, unswept.
The Pear Garden disciples had new white hair,
The pepper-chamber eunuchs and palace maids had grown old.
In the evening hall fireflies flitted, his thoughts ran silent and sad,
He trimmed the lonely lamp till the wick was gone, yet still could not sleep.
Slowly the bells and drums marked the early long night,
The bright River of Stars grew pale as dawn approached.
The mandarin-duck tiles were cold under heavy frost,
The kingfisher quilt was chill—who would share it now?
Life and death separated them, year after slow year,
Yet her spirit never once came to him in dreams.
A Taoist from Linqiong was a guest in the capital,
Who could summon spirits through his sincere devotion.
Moved by the Emperor's tossing, restless longing,
He bade the magician search for her diligently.
Cleaving the clouds, riding the ether, rushing like lightning,
He mounted heaven and entered earth, searching everywhere.
Above he pierced to the azure sky, below to the Yellow Springs,
But both places were vast and empty, and she was nowhere found.
Suddenly he heard of an immortal mountain upon the sea,
A mountain that lay in the realm of nothingness and mist.
Exquisite pavilions rose among five-colored clouds,
Within them dwelt many graceful fairy maidens.
Among them was one whose name was Taizhen,
With snow-white skin and flower-like face—it must be she.
At the golden west chamber he knocked on the jade door,
Asked Xiaoyu to announce him to Shuangcheng.
When she heard that the Han Emperor's envoy had come,
She woke with a start within her nine-flowered curtain.
She drew on her robe, pushed aside the pillow, rose and lingered,
Pearl blinds and silver screens opened one by one.
Her cloud-hair was half askew, she had just awakened,
Her flower cap unarranged, she came down to the hall.
The wind blew her fairy sleeves, fluttering and rising,
As if she still danced the "Rainbow Skirts and Feather Robes."
Her jade face was lonely, tears streamed down her cheeks,
Like a spray of pear blossoms in spring, laden with rain.
With tender feeling she gazed intently, thanking the Emperor,
Since parting, voice and face had grown dim and distant.
The love of Zhaoyang Hall was ended forever,
In Penglai Palace the days and months stretched long.
Turning her head she looked down upon the mortal world,
Chang'an was hidden from sight—only dust and fog.
She could but send old tokens to express her deep devotion,
The inlaid box and golden hairpin she sent back with him.
One prong of the pin she kept, one panel of the box,
Breaking the golden pin, dividing the inlaid box.
If only our hearts remain as firm as gold and inlay,
In heaven or on earth we shall surely meet again.
At parting she charged him earnestly with these words,
Words that held a vow known only to two hearts.
On the seventh day of the seventh month, in the Hall of Long Life,
At midnight when no one was near, we spoke in private whispers.
"In heaven we shall be birds flying wing to wing,"
"On earth we shall be trees with branches intertwined."
Heaven is long, earth enduring, yet both shall have an end,
But this everlasting regret stretches on, forever unfulfilled.

title: 问刘十九
author: 白居易
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
【问刘十九】唐代白居易所作的诗。
tr: 绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉。晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无？。
appr: 《问刘十九》是唐代白居易所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《问刘十九》历代传诵不衰，是白居易诗歌风格的集中体现。
st:
【起·开篇】前1句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第2至2句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第3至3句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末2句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。

bg: 《问刘十九》为唐代白居易所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者白居易在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《问刘十九》主旨在于诗人即景抒怀，韵味深厚，表达了真挚深沉的思想感情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代白居易的代表性作品之一。

小小的红泥炉火烧得正旺。

老朋友，能不能来陪我喝一杯酒？

en_lines: Newly brewed rice wine, green foam unstrained,
The little red earthen stove glows warm and bright.
Evening draws on, the sky looks set for snow,
Dear friend, will you not come and share a cup?

title: 春思
author: 皇甫冉
note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。
【春思】唐代皇甫冉所作的诗。
tr: 鶯啼燕語報新年，馬邑龍堆路幾千。家住秦城鄰漢苑，心隨明月到胡天。機中錦字論長恨，樓上花枝笑獨眠。爲問元戎竇車騎，何時反斾勒燕然。
appr: 《春思》是唐代皇甫冉所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《春思》历代传诵不衰，是皇甫冉诗歌风格的集中体现。
st:
【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。

baihua_lines: 莺啼燕语报新年已经到来，
马邑龙堆的道路远在天边，相距几千余里。
在长安城的家中，伴着花丛化着晚妆，
楼上对着明月，心事满怀，独自愁坐。
机中的锦字织出了回文诗，诉说着相思情意，
这无边的春色哪里会懂得遥远的思念？
为问出征的车骑将军窦宪，
何时才能班师回朝，刻石燕然，胜利归来？
baihua: 莺啼燕语报新年，马邑龙堆路几千。家住秦城邻汉苑，心随明月到胡天。机中锦字论长恨，楼上花枝笑独眠。为问元戎窦车骑，何时反斾勒燕然。
en_lines: Orioles sing, swallows twitter—they announce the new year,
But the roads to Mayi and Longdui lie thousands of li away.
In Chang'an homes, ladies touch up evening makeup by the flowers,
Alone in upper chambers they sit sorrowful before the moon.
The brocade characters woven on the loom tell of longing,
But this boundless spring beauty knows nothing of distant grief.
I ask of the general who leads the cavalry on the frontier,
When will he return victorious, his name carved on Yanran Mountain?

title: 望蓟门
author: 祖咏
note: 《望蓟门》是祖咏的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【望蓟门】唐代祖咏所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 登上燕台远望，客居在外的人心中顿生惊慨，
笳鼓声声喧腾，原来那是汉将的军营。
连绵千里的积雪，笼罩着寒光，映照着旗帜，
三边之地的曙色中，巍巍的蓟城高入云端。
战场上的烽火连着胡地的明月，
渤海边的云山拥围着蓟门。
少小时虽然就仰慕过投笔从戎的壮举，
而今想要论功报效国家，却还未曾如愿。
baihua: 燕台一望客心惊，箫鼓喧喧汉将营。万里寒光生积雪，三边曙色动危旌。沙场烽火连胡月，海畔云山拥蓟城。少小虽非投笔吏，论功还欲请长缨。
en_lines: Climbing Yan Tower to gaze afar, the traveler's heart stirs with awe,
Flutes and drums resound noisily—this is the Han general's camp.
A thousand li of lingering snow casts cold light upon the banners,
In dawn over the three borderlands, Jimen City towers to the clouds.
Beacon fires on the battlefield connect to the barbarian moon,
Cloudy mountains by the Bohai Sea enclose the strategic pass.
Though in youth I admired casting aside the pen to serve the nation,
I have yet to win merit or repay my country's grace.

Lingering snow on the peaks seems to float above the clouds.
After the sky clears, treetops gleam in the sunlit air,
As evening falls, Chang'an is touched by added cold.

baihua_lines: 我生在蓬门荜户，从来不知绮罗的香气，
想托媒人说亲，心里就更加感伤。
有谁会爱我这高尚风雅的格调品格？
世上的人都喜爱时髦的梳妆打扮。
我敢夸耀十指灵巧，针线活做得出众，
从不把双眉画得细长与人争艳。
深恨年年手里压着金线刺绣，
到头来都是替别的女子做嫁衣裳。
baihua: 蓬门未识绮罗香，拟托良媒益自伤。谁爱风流高格调，共怜时世俭梳妆。敢将十指夸偏巧，不把双眉鬬画长。苦恨年年压金线，为他人作嫁衣裳。
en_lines: Born in a humble thatched home, I never knew the scent of silk brocade,
To ask a matchmaker to arrange my marriage only deepens my sorrow.
Who loves the noble, graceful character I possess?
The world admires only the latest fashions in makeup and dress.
I dare boast of my ten fingers' skill at fine needlework,
Yet never paint my brows long to compete in beauty with others.
I bitterly press golden thread with my hands year after year,
Only to stitch wedding gowns for other brides.

title: 春泛若耶溪
author: 綦毋潜
note: 《春泛若耶溪》是綦毋潜的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【春泛若耶溪】唐代綦毋潜所作的诗。
tr: 幽意無斷絕，此去隨所偶。晚風吹行舟，花路入溪口。際夜轉西壑，隔山望南斗。潭煙飛溶溶，林月低向後。生事且彌漫，願爲持竿叟。

baihua_lines: 幽居归隐的心意从未断绝，
此次乘着小船一路沿溪漫游。
晚风吹送着船儿任意西东，
春花夹岸，花影映入溪口。
夜晚潭水在烟月下格外空明，
林梢低垂，月亮仿佛挂得更低。
尘世间的事纷纷扰扰没有尽头，
我愿沿着这溪水一直漂流下去。
像那持竿垂钓的沧洲老翁，
我真想随你一同归隐江湖。
baihua: 幽意无断绝，此去随所偶。晚风吹行舟，花路入溪口。际夜转西壑，隔山望南斗。潭烟飞溶溶，林月低向后。生事且弥漫，愿为持竿叟。
en_lines: My longing for secluded retreat has never ceased,
I take a small boat and drift along the stream.
Evening wind carries the vessel whither it will,
Spring flowers line both banks, shadows meeting at the river mouth.
At night the pool lies clear beneath a misty moon,
Treetops hang low as the moon dips close.
Worldly affairs are tangled and never-ending,
I would follow this stream and drift away forever.
Like the old fisherman of Cangzhou with pole in hand,
I long to go with you and retire to rivers and lakes.

author: 薛逢

她们在望仙楼上翘盼君王临幸。
金兽衔环的宫门紧锁着，
铜龙滴漏静静计量着白日时光。
云髻松松梳成了堕马髻，
春衣上浅浅绣着折枝花纹。
遥遥望着未央宫前的杨柳，
不知又有多少柳枝被攀折送别离人。
baihua: 十二楼中尽晓妆，望仙楼上望君王。锁衔金兽连环冷，水滴铜龙昼漏长。云髻罢梳还对镜，罗衣欲换更添香。遥窥正殿帘开处，袍袴宫人扫御床。
en_lines: In the twelve palace towers all have finished their morning toilet,
From Wangxian Tower they gaze hopefully for the Emperor's favor.
Palace gates with golden animal knockers are locked fast,
The bronze dragon water clock drips steadily through the day.
Cloud-like tresses are loosely combed into falling-horse buns,
Spring robes are lightly embroidered with broken-branch patterns.
From afar they gaze at the willows before Weiyang Palace,
Wondering how many branches will be plucked for departing friends.

title: 送崔九
author: 裴迪
note: 《送崔九》是裴迪的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【送崔九】唐代裴迪所作的诗。
tr: 归山深浅去。须尽丘壑美。莫学武陵人。暂游桃源里。

baihua_lines: 你这次入山隐居，无论深处浅处都要游遍，
一定要尽情欣赏那山丘沟壑的秀美。
千万别学那个武陵的渔人，
只是短暂地在桃花源里游了一趟就出来了。
baihua: 归山深浅去。须尽丘壑美。莫学武陵人。暂游桃源里。
en_lines: Returning to the mountains, wander through every depth and height,
Drink your fill of all the beauty of hills and vales.
Do not be like the fisherman of Wuling,
Who but briefly visited Peach Blossom Spring before leaving.

en_lines: The seven stars of the Dipper hang high in the sky,
General Geshu patrols each night with sword at his side.
Even now the barbarians dare only pasture horses from afar,
Never daring to cross southward over Lintao.

title: 早秋
author: 许浑
note: 《早秋》是许浑的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【早秋】唐代许浑所作的诗。
tr: 嫩菊含新彩，遠山閑夕煙。涼風驚綠樹，清韻入朱弦。思婦機中錦，征人塞外天。鴈飛魚在水，書信若爲傳。

baihua_lines: 初生的嫩菊含着新放的光彩，
远处山间笼罩着傍晚的烟霭。
凉风吹过，惊动了绿树叶子，
清雅的音韵从朱红琴弦上流出。
思妇在机中织着锦字回文，
征人远在塞外的长天之下。
大雁南飞，鱼儿游在水中，
两地相隔，书信又怎能传递？
baihua: 嫩菊含新彩，远山闲夕烟。凉风惊绿树，清韵入朱弦。思妇机中锦，征人塞外天。鴈飞鱼在水，书信若为传。
en_lines: Tender chrysanthemums hold fresh new hues,
Distant mountains are veiled in evening mist.
Cool winds stir and rustle through the green leaves,
Pure, clear tones resound from vermilion strings.
A longing wife weaves brocade love-letters at her loom,
Her soldier husband stands beneath the distant frontier sky.
Wild geese fly south; fish swim in the waters,
With such distance between us, how can letters ever reach?

title: 秋日赴阙题潼关驿楼
author: 许浑
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。

tr: 紅葉晚蕭蕭，長亭酒一瓢。殘雲歸太華，疎雨過中條。樹色隨山迥，河聲入海遙。帝鄉明日到，猶自夢漁樵。

baihua_lines: 红叶在晚风中萧萧飘落，
长亭酒瓢里还留着潼关的酒。
残云在太华山上空飘荡，
稀疏雨点流过中条山。
树色沿着关隘一直延伸向远方，
黄河涛声奔涌着向东流入大海。
到了京城莫要问我名利的事，
我自从生病以来，学道的心就更浓了。
baihua: 红叶晚萧萧，长亭酒一瓢。残云归太华，疎雨过中条。树色随山迥，河声入海遥。帝乡明日到，犹自梦渔樵。
en_lines: Red leaves drift down sere in the evening wind,
At the long pavilion my wine gourd still holds Tongguan wine.
Remnant clouds drift above the peaks of Mount Taihua,
Sparse rain showers flow across Zhongtiao Mountain.
Tree colors follow the passes stretching far away,
The roaring Yellow River surges onward to the sea.
When I reach the capital ask me not of fame or fortune,
Since my illness, my desire to study the Way has grown deeper.

title: 回乡偶书
author: 贺知章
note: 【春风】春日和风，常喻恩泽、喜悦或美好时光。
【回乡偶书】唐代贺知章所作的诗。
tr: 少小离家老大回。乡音无改鬓毛衰。儿童相见不相识。笑问客从何处来。离别家乡岁月多。近来人事半消磨。惟有门前镜湖水。春风不改旧时波。

baihua_lines: 年少时离开家乡，到老了才回来，
乡音没有改变，但两鬓头发已经斑白稀疏。
家乡的孩子们看见我，却都不认识我，
他们笑着问：客人你是从哪里来的？
离别家乡已经很多很多年了，
回来后发现人事消磨，一切都变了大半。
只有门前那一镜湖的碧水，
春风不改旧时波纹，依旧像从前一样。
baihua: 少小离家老大回。乡音无改鬓毛衰。儿童相见不相识。笑问客从何处来。离别家乡岁月多。近来人事半消磨。惟有门前镜湖水。春风不改旧时波。
en_lines: I left home when young and returned only in old age,
My native accent unchanged, but the hair at my temples has turned white and thin.
Children of my hometown see me and know me not,
They smile and ask: "Sir, where do you come from?"
The years since I left home have been many, many indeed,
Returning I find that people and affairs have mostly changed.
Only the clear green waters of Mirror Lake before my gate,
Its waves unchanged by spring winds, remain just as before.

他说师傅已经上山采药去了。
就在这座大山里面，
可是云雾太深，不知道他具体在哪里。

en_lines: Beneath the pines I asked the young apprentice,
He said his master had gone to gather herbs on the mountain.
"He is somewhere in this very mountain,"
"But the clouds are so deep I cannot tell exactly where."

title: 马嵬坡
author: 郑畋

往日恩爱难忘，而国家已是日月重光。

en_lines: When Emperor Xuanzong returned from Shu, Lady Yang had perished,
Their love unforgettable, yet the dynasty had renewed like sun and moon.
In the end the Son of Heaven made a clear-sighted decision,
While Chen Houzhu, hiding in the Jingyang Palace well, was no ruler at all.

en_lines: Oh, drive that yellow oriole away,
Do not let it sing upon the branches.
Its cries would shatter my sweet dream,
Preventing me from reaching Liaoxi to meet my love.

title: 谷口书斋寄杨补阙
author: 钱起
note: 《谷口书斋寄杨补阙》是钱起的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【谷口书斋寄杨补阙】唐代钱起所作的诗。
tr: 泉壑帶茅茨，雲霞生薜帷。竹憐新雨後，山愛夕陽時。閑鷺棲常早，秋花落更遲。家童掃蘿逕，昨與故人期。

baihua_lines: 清泉沟壑环绕着我的茅屋，
云霞从竹丛间冉冉升起。
雨后竹林幽静，带着新润的气息，
山光里夕阳西下，含着无限情意。
闲鹭常常来这里栖息，
秋花飘落，覆盖了阶前的苔藓。
家僮并没有特意打扫萝径，
昨夜才听说你要来山中的消息。
baihua: 泉壑带茅茨，云霞生薜帷。竹怜新雨后，山爱夕阳时。闲鹭栖常早，秋花落更迟。家童扫萝迳，昨与故人期。
en_lines: Springs and ravines wind around my thatched cottage,
Rosy clouds rise up gently from amid the bamboo groves.
The bamboo after rain holds quiet, fresh moisture,
In mountain light the setting sun glows with tender feeling.
Idle egrets often come to roost here,
Autumn blossoms drift down to cover the moss before the steps.
My servant has not yet swept the vine-strewn path,
Only last night did I hear you were coming to the mountains.

title: 赠阙下裴舍人
author: 钱起

baihua_lines: 二月的黄莺飞到了上林苑里，
清晨的曙光映着紫禁城，春色万千。
长乐宫的钟声在花外渐渐消散，
龙池边的柳色在雨中更显青翠。
阳光里，千门万户次第打开帘幕，
官员朝衣上带着御炉的香气。
我这失意之人年华已老，
年年空看杨柳发青，空有渭川垂钓之心。
baihua: 二月黄莺飞上林，春城紫禁晓阴阴。长乐钟声花外尽，龙池柳色雨中深。阳和不散穷途恨，霄汉长怀捧日新。献赋十年犹未遇，羞将白发对华簪。
en_lines: In second month yellow orioles fly to Shanglin Park,
Morning dawn light floods the Purple Forbidden City with spring's thousand hues.
Changle Palace bells die away beyond the blossoms,
Willows by the Dragon Pool grow deeper green in the rain.
In sunlight the thousand gates open their blinds one by one,
Court robes are fragrant with incense from the imperial censers.
I am a frustrated man whose years have grown old,
Watching willows turn green year after year, my Wei River fishing heart unfulfilled.

title: 送僧归日本
author: 钱起
note: 《送僧归日本》是钱起的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【送僧归日本】唐代钱起所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 你随缘来到中国，如今随缘归去，
佛法如浮杯渡海，来去宛如梦中。
水中月影通于禅寂之理，
鱼龙也静听你诵经的声音。
一点灯火照亮你归途的长夜，
小船远去，只剩下海上的风。
你与中国的尘缘已经了结，
相隔万里，只能在心中怀念故国。
baihua: 上国随缘住，来途若梦行。浮天沧海远，去世法舟轻。水月通禅观，鱼龙听梵声。惟怜一灯影，万里眼中明。
en_lines: You came to our land by fate, and by fate you return,
The Dharma floats like a cup across the sea, coming and going as in a dream.
The moon in water embodies Zen's tranquil truth,
Fish and dragons listen silently to your sutra chanting.
Your single lamp lights the long journey homeward,
Your boat sails far away, leaving only the ocean wind.
Your worldly ties to this land are now ended,
Across ten thousand li, you will hold this country in your heart.

baihua_lines: 向前看不见古代的贤君圣主，
向后望不到后世的明主贤人。
想到天地宇宙是这样悠悠无尽，
我独自悲怆，泪水禁不住潸然而下。
baihua: 前不见古人，后不见来者。念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下！。
en_lines: Looking before me, I see not the ancient sages,
Looking behind me, I see not the wise rulers yet to come.
Thinking of heaven and earth, eternal and unending,
Alone in my sorrow, tears stream down my face.

五千身着貂锦战袍的精兵战死在胡尘中。

baihua: 誓扫匈奴不顾身。五千貂锦丧胡尘。可怜无定河边骨。犹是春闺梦里人。
en_lines: Swearing to sweep away the Xiongnu, they gave no thought to their own lives,
Five thousand soldiers in sable and brocade perished in the barbarian dust.
Pitiful are the white bones that lie by the Wuding River,
Still the ones their young wives dream of in spring boudoirs.

六朝往事如梦，只有江鸟空自啼叫。

en_lines: Rain drifts over the river, the river banks grow thick with grass,
The Six Dynasties pass like a dream, only river birds cry in vain.
Most heartless of all are the willows beside Taicheng,
Which still veil the ten-li embankment in mist just as in old days.

title: 章台夜思
author: 韦庄
note: 《章台夜思》是韦庄的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【章台夜思】唐代韦庄所作的诗。
tr: 清瑟怨遙夜，遶弦風雨哀。孤燈聞楚角，殘月下章臺。芳草已云暮，故人殊未來。鄉書不可寄，秋雁又南迴。

baihua_lines: 清越的瑟声在长夜里哀怨地响起，
章台之夜，缭绕着我思乡的愁绪。
芳草已生，楚国的原野辽阔，
华山高耸，归乡的路途遥远。
孤灯之下，我在楚地作客思乡，
残月高悬楼上，让人想起故园明月。
连家书都已经无法寄到，
更何况秋雁又开始南飞了。
baihua: 清瑟怨遥夜，遶弦风雨哀。孤灯闻楚角，残月下章台。芳草已云暮，故人殊未来。乡书不可寄，秋雁又南回。
en_lines: The clear se plays its plaintive tune through the long night,
Night at Zhangtai fills me with longing for my distant home.
Fragrant grass has grown; the Chu plains stretch wide and far,
Mount Hua rises high; the road home is long indeed.
Before a lonely lamp I sit, a stranger in the south,
The waning moon hangs over the tower, recalling my homeland.
Even family letters can no longer reach me,
All the more as autumn geese turn southward in their flight.

title: 菩萨蛮·人人尽说
author: 韦庄
note: 【江南】长江以南地区，以水乡风光、温婉秀丽著称。

baihua_lines: 人人都说江南好，
游人就应该在江南终老一生。
春天的江水比蓝天还要清澈碧绿，
在彩绘的船上听着雨声入眠，多么惬意。
垆边卖酒的女子像月亮一样明媚，
洁白的手腕宛如凝霜堆雪。
年纪未老的时候可不要还乡啊，
回到故乡一定会因离愁而肝肠寸断。
baihua: 人人尽说江南好，游人只合江南老。春水碧于天，画船听雨眠。垆边人似月，皓腕凝霜雪。未老莫还乡，还乡须断肠。
en_lines: All men sing the praises of Jiangnan,
A traveler should stay and grow old in Jiangnan.
Spring river waters are bluer than the sky itself,
How sweet to lie in a painted boat and listen to the rain.
The wine-shop maid is as lovely as the moon,
Her white wrists are like frozen frost and snow.
Do not return home before your years are old,
For returning home would surely break your heart with longing.

title: 金陵图
author: 韦庄
note: 《金陵图》是韦庄的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【金陵图】唐代韦庄所作的诗。
tr: 誰謂傷心畫不成，畫人心逐世人情。君看六幅南朝事，老木寒雲滿故城。

眼前这画面就足以令人伤心。
只有那最是无情的台城柳，

The scene before my eyes breaks the heart enough.
Only the heartless willows of Taicheng,
Still veil the ten-li embankment in mist, just as of old.

title: 东郊
author: 韦应物
note: 【青山】青翠的山峦，常象征永恒、宁静与归隐。
【东郊】唐代韦应物所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 在官府里整年局促受拘束，
到郊外漫步，才觉出心情舒畅。
杨柳在和风中散发出温柔的气息，
青山冲淡了我心中的烦恼和郁积。
依在丛林旁小憩歇息，
沿着山涧徘徊流连。
微雨过后，芬芳的野草滋长，
春鸠不知在什么地方啼鸣。
我素来就喜爱清幽闲适，
又被这里的景物深深挽留。
此情此景真有陶渊明辞官归田的乐趣，
只可惜我与他隔着久远的年代。
baihua: 吏舍跼终年，出郊旷清曙。杨柳散和风，青山澹吾虑。依丛适自憩，缘涧还复去。微雨霭芳原，春鸠鸣何处？乐幽心屡止，遵事迹犹遽。终罢斯结庐，慕陶真可庶。
en_lines: All year long I am cramped in official quarters,
Only by walking in the eastern suburbs do I find release.
Willows breathe softness in the gentle breeze,
Green hills wash away the pent-up cares in my breast.
I lean against the grove to rest a while,
Lingering along the mountain stream.
After light rain, fragrant grasses grow lush,
Where does the spring turtledove sing?
I have always loved quiet and leisure,
And the scenery here holds me fast.
This joy is that of Tao Yuanming returning home,
Though we are separated by long ages.

author: 韦应物
note: 【初发扬子寄元大校书】唐代韦应物所作的诗。

baihua_lines: 凄凄然地离开亲爱的好友，
乘船驶入扬子江的烟雨之中。
我这只归棹前往洛阳，与你相隔千里，
在残钟的余音里，我们就此分别。
今天在这里分手，
不知何年何月才能再次相见。
世事如同波浪般漂泊无定，
真不如停在岸边的白鸥那样自在。
baihua: 凄凄去亲爱，泛泛入烟雾。归棹洛阳人，残钟广陵树。今朝此为别，何处还相遇。世事波上舟，沿洄安得住。
en_lines: Sadly I take leave of my dear friend,
Sailing into the misty rain of the Yangtze.
My home-bound boat heads to Luoyang a thousand li away,
As the last bell fades, we must part.
Today we separate here,
Not knowing in what year or month we shall meet again.
Worldly affairs drift like restless waves,
Less free than the white gulls resting on the shore.

title: 夕次盱眙县
author: 韦应物

baihua_lines: 落下船帆，停船在淮河边的小镇，
船只停靠在孤零零的驿馆前。
浩浩大风从波浪间吹来，
太阳落山时，江城一片萧索冷清。
我独自行进在山路上，为何要在这里停留？
只因想起了故山中的家园。
天边归雁都已经飞远了，
我的愁绪和夜晚的淮河水一样悠长。
baihua: 落帆逗淮镇，停舫临孤驿。浩浩风起波，冥冥日沈夕。人归山郭暗，雁下芦洲白。独夜忆秦关，听钟未眠客。
en_lines: Lowering sail I put in at the small town by the Huai River,
My boat moored before the lonely post station.
Mighty gales blow in across the waves,
As the sun sets, the river town grows still and desolate.
Traveling the mountain roads alone, why do I pause?
Thinking of my old home garden in the hills.
Homeward geese at the edge of sky have all flown far away,
My melancholy stretches as long as the Huai at night.

baihua_lines: 今天在郡斋里，天气转冷，
我忽然想起了山中的老朋友。
你一定是提着篮子到涧底打柴了，
回来煮白石英来充饥。
我想送一瓢酒给你，
好让你在风雨之夜得到一点慰藉。
可是空山里落叶堆满了山路，
我不知道你究竟在什么地方。
baihua: 今朝郡斋冷，忽念山中客。涧底束荆薪，归来煮白石。欲持一瓢酒，远慰风雨夕。落叶满空山，何处寻行迹。
en_lines: Today in my prefectural study the weather turns cold,
Suddenly I think of my old friend in the mountains.
You must have taken your basket to gather firewood by the stream,
Returning to boil white quartz to allay your hunger.
I long to send you a gourd of wine,
To bring you comfort on this windy, rainy night.
But in the empty mountains fallen leaves pile high on the paths,
I have no idea where you might be.

author: 韦应物

baihua_lines: 去年花开的时候，我们与你相逢又分别，
今天花开时节，已经过去整整一年。
世事茫茫，前途难以预料，
春愁漫漫，我独自失眠。
身多疾病，常想辞官回乡种田，
看到治下百姓流亡，我拿着俸禄深感惭愧。
听说你要来探望我的消息，
我多次在西楼上望月，盼你到来。
baihua: 去年花里逢君别，今日花开已一年。世事茫茫难自料，春愁黯黯独成眠。身多疾病思田里，邑有流亡愧俸钱。闻道欲来相问讯，西楼望月几廻圆。
en_lines: Last year among the blossoms we met and parted,
Now flowers bloom again, a whole year has passed.
Worldly affairs are vast, the future hard to foretell,
Spring sorrows are endless; I lie sleepless and alone.
Plagued by illness, I often long to retire and farm,
Seeing refugees in my prefecture, I am ashamed to draw my salary.
Hearing news that you might come to visit,
I have watched the moon from the west tower many a night.

baihua_lines: 当年我们曾一同在江汉作客，
每次相逢，每回醉酒，都是和你在一起。
像浮云一样分别后，流水般十年过去了。
今天相逢欢笑，感情依旧像从前一样。
你问我为什么回来得这么晚，
我双鬓已斑白，对着你只能流泪。
何因不归去，诗人借景抒情感怀心绪。
足够让我流连终老。
baihua: 江汉曾为客，相逢每醉还。浮云一别后，流水十年间。欢笑情如旧，萧疏鬓已斑。何因不归去？淮上有秋山。
en_lines: We were once sojourners together by the Jianghan rivers,
Every meeting, every drunken bout was shared with you.
After drifting clouds we parted, ten years flowed by like water.
Meeting now we laugh, our affection as warm as before.
You ask why I returned so late,
My temples have turned white; I can only weep before you.
Why not go back? The Huai river has autumn mountains,
Their beauty is enough to make me stay until my days end.

translation: 獨憐幽草澗邊生，上有黃鸝深樹鳴。春潮帶雨晚來急，野渡無人舟自橫。
appreciation: 《滁州西涧》是唐代韦应物所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「獨憐幽草澗邊生，」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，情景交融，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《滁州西涧》历代传诵不衰，是韦应物诗歌风格的集中体现。

树丛深处有黄鹂在婉转啼鸣。
春潮伴着夜雨，水势湍急，
荒野的渡口无人渡河，只有渡船自在横漂。

en_lines: I love alone the quiet grass growing by the stream,
In deep foliage orioles sing their melodious songs.
Spring tides rise with evening rain, the current rushes swift,
At the lonely ferry no travelers cross; the boat drifts freely across.

这个秋夜在我这里是那样漫长。
空山里松子坠落的声音清晰可闻，
幽居的你应该还没有入睡吧。
baihua: 怀君属秋夜，散步咏凉天。山空松子落，幽人应未眠。
en_lines: As I think of you this autumn night, I imagine you thinking of me,
This autumn night stretches long where I dwell.
In the empty mountains pine cones fall audibly,
You in your hermitage must still be awake.

title: 赋得暮雨送李胄
author: 韦应物
note: 《赋得暮雨送李胄》是韦应物的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【赋得暮雨送李胄】唐代韦应物所作的诗。
tr: 楚江微雨裏，建業暮鐘時。漠漠帆來重，冥冥鳥去遲。海門深不見，浦樹遠含滋。相送情無限，沾襟比散絲。

baihua_lines: 楚江上飘着濛濛细雨，
建业城传来傍晚的钟声。
沉重的船帆被雨幕打湿，
迟归的鸟儿在雨中飞得缓慢。
海门处潮水涌起，看不见遥远的渡口，
江边的树木在雨雾中更显萧疏。
我们的离别之情是这样绵长无尽，
沾湿衣襟的不只是暮雨。
baihua: 楚江微雨里，建业暮钟时。漠漠帆来重，冥冥鸟去迟。海门深不见，浦树远含滋。相送情无限，沾襟比散丝。
en_lines: A fine misty rain falls on the Chu River,
Jianye City rings with the sound of evening bells.
Heavy sails hang damp and soaked within the curtain of rain,
Birds returning late fly slowly through the downpour.
At the sea gate the tide rises, hiding the distant crossing,
Riverside trees grow sparse and dim in the misty rain.
Our feelings at parting stretch long and without bound,
It is not only rain that dampens the lapels of our robes.

title: 送杨氏女
author: 韦应物
note: 《送杨氏女》是韦应物的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【送杨氏女】唐代韦应物所作的诗。
tr: 永日方慼慼，出門復悠悠。女子今有行，大江泝輕舟。爾輩況無恃，撫念益慈柔。幼爲長所育，兩別泣不休。對此結中腸，義往難復留。自小闕內訓，事姑貽我憂。賴茲託令門，仁恤庶無尤。貧儉誠所尚，資從豈待周。孝恭遵婦道，容止順其猷。別離在今晨，見爾當何秋。居閑始自遣，臨感忽難收。歸來視幼女，零淚緣纓流。

translation: 永日方慼慼，出門復悠悠。女子今有行，大江泝輕舟。爾輩況無恃，撫念益慈柔。幼爲長所育，兩別泣不休。對此結中腸，義往難復留。自小闕內訓，事姑貽我憂。賴茲託令門，仁恤庶無尤。貧儉誠所尚，資從豈待周。孝恭遵婦道，容止順其猷。別離在今晨，見爾當何秋。居閑始自遣，臨感忽難收。歸來視幼女，零淚緣纓流。

baihua_lines: 整整一天我心里悲戚不安，
出嫁的女儿就要沿河上路了。
你们姐妹俩从小就没了母亲，
我这做父亲的对你们更加怜爱。
妹妹从小由奶妈抚养长大，
你们俩哭着互相搀扶，不忍分离。
我这个做父亲的心中最为难受，
看到你们临别的样子，更是难言。
自从你们小时候失去母亲，
我把你们抚养长大，备尝辛苦。
姐姐你为人一向端庄贤惠，
我对你的抚养教导自认没有差错。
今天就要送你嫁到杨家去，
希望你到了婆家好好侍奉公婆。
要做到谦恭和顺，
仪容举止都要合乎礼节规范。
父女姐妹就要分别了，
看到你远去，我内心的愁苦难以平息。
你这一去，回来省亲的日子就少了，
我独自回家，看到小女儿更觉孤单。
小孩子不懂事，不知道离别的愁苦，
她依偎在我身边，只顾着低头玩耍。
想到这里我心里更加悲痛，
站在门里门外，久久难以平静。
baihua: 永日方戚戚，出门复悠悠。女子今有行，大江溯轻舟。尔辈况无恃，抚念益慈柔。幼为长所育，两别泣不休。对此结中肠，义往难复留。自小阙内训，事姑贻我忧。赖兹托令门，仁恤庶无尤。贫俭诚所尚，资从岂待周。孝恭遵妇道，容止顺其猷。别离在今晨，见尔当何秋。居闲始自遣，临感忽难收。归来视幼女，零泪缘缨流。
en_lines: All day long my heart has been heavy with sorrow,
My daughter is departing, traveling along the river.
You two sisters lost your mother when you were young,
Which made me, your father, cherish you all the more.
The younger sister was raised by her nursemaid,
You both weep and cling to each other, loath to part.
A father's heart suffers more than words can tell,
Seeing you face this parting, pain beyond expression.
Since you lost your mother in childhood,
I have raised you both through hardship and toil.
Elder sister, you have always been upright and virtuous,
In my care and teaching, I believe I did my best.
Today I marry you into the Yang family,
I hope you will serve your parents-in-law well.
May you be humble, obedient, and gentle,
Your conduct and decorum always according to the rites.
Father and daughters, sisters, must now part,
Seeing you go far away, my grief will not be stilled.
Once gone, your visits home will be few,
Returning alone to the house, I find the younger all the lonelier.
The child is too young to understand parting sorrow,
She leans against my side, absorbed in her play.
Thinking of this my heart breaks further,
Inside and outside the gate I stand long, emotions unresolved.

author: 韦应物

baihua_lines: 卫兵们持画戟森然排列，
我在斋中休息，身心安宁。
海上的风雨忽然到来，
池塘和池馆间平添一阵清凉。
我这多病之身，
幸喜遇到这丰收的好年成。
作为地方长官，
得闲时与诸位文士聚饮欢宴。
我惭愧地享用着这份俸禄，
又喜得名士满座，嘉宾如云。
我的德行浅薄，
怎能接待这些贤明的君子呢？
大家在酒席上谈论大道真理，
笔墨都已准备妥当。
赋诗来抒发各自的情怀，
醉后便忘记了尘世的荣辱。
我心里一直挂念着政务，
看到诸位宾客，暂时忘记了烦恼。
吴中向来物产丰美，
但今天的欢会全因诸位嘉宾。
baihua: 兵卫森画戟，宴寝凝清香。海上风雨至，逍遥池阁凉。烦疴近消散，嘉宾复满堂。自慙居处崇，未覩斯民康。理会是非遣，性达形迹忘。鲜肥属时禁，蔬果幸见尝。俯饮一杯酒，仰聆金玉章。神欢体自轻，意欲凌风翔。吴中盛文史，群彦今汪洋。方知大藩地，岂曰财赋疆。
en_lines: Guards with painted halberds stand in impressive array,
I rest in my study, body and mind at peace.
Wind and rain from the sea arrive suddenly,
Bringing fresh coolness to ponds and pavilions.
With my body often beset by illness,
I rejoice to live in a year of abundant harvest.
Serving as prefect of this district,
I find leisure to feast with you literary gentlemen.
I receive my salary with some sense of shame,
Yet rejoice in this gathering of talented guests.
My own virtue is slight,
How am I fit to host such worthy gentlemen?
At the feast we discourse upon the Great Way,
Brushes and ink have been prepared.
We compose poems to express our inmost feelings,
Drunk with wine, we forget all thoughts of worldly glory or disgrace.
My mind ever turns to my official duties,
But seeing my guests, I briefly set my worries aside.
The land of Wu has always been rich in produce,
But today's joy springs from you, my honored guests.

title: 长安遇冯著

baihua_lines: 朋友你从东方来到长安，
衣服上还沾着灞陵的春雨。
问你为何来到这里，
你说为买斧来山中采樵归隐。
冥冥的春花正悄悄地开过，
新来的燕子正在衔泥筑巢。
去年分别的时候，
你鬓发还没白，怎么就白了呢？
baihua: 客从东方来，衣上灞陵雨。问客何为来，采山因买斧。冥冥花正开，飏飏燕新乳。昨别今已春，鬓丝生几缕。
en_lines: My friend, you have come to Chang'an from the east,
Your clothes still bear the spring rain of Baling.
I ask you why you have come here,
You say you've come to buy an axe to gather firewood in retirement.
Unseen spring blossoms have quietly fallen,
Newly arrived swallows are busy building nests.
When we parted last year,
The hair at your temples was not yet white—how has it turned gray so soon?

title: 已凉
author: 韩偓
note: 《已凉》是韩偓的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【已凉】唐代韩偓所作的诗。
tr: 碧阑干外绣帘垂。猩色屛风画折枝。八尺龙须方锦褥。已凉天气未寒时。

en_lines: Beyond the jade-green railing embroidered curtains hang low,
On the crimson screen are painted broken branches of blossoms.
A dragon-beard grass mat covers the ivory-inlaid bed,
The weather has turned cool, though snow has not yet fallen.

title: 八月十五夜赠张功曹
author: 韩愈
note: 【八月十五夜赠张功曹】唐代韩愈所作的诗。
tr: 纖雲四卷天無河，清風吹空月舒波。沙平水息聲影絕，一桮相屬君當歌。君歌聲酸辭且苦，不能聽終淚如雨。洞庭連天九疑高，蛟龍出沒猩鼯號。十生九死到官所，幽居默默如藏逃。下牀畏蛇食畏藥，海氣濕蟄熏腥臊。昨者州前搥大鼓，嗣皇繼聖登夔臯。赦書一日行萬里，罪從大辟皆除死。遷者追廻流者還，滌瑕蕩垢清朝班。州家申名使家抑，坎軻祗得移荆蠻。判司卑官不堪說，未免捶楚塵埃間。同時輩流多上道，天路幽險難追攀。君歌且休聽我歌，我歌今與君殊科。

baihua_lines: 薄云四处散尽，天上看不见银河，
清风吹拂夜空，月亮洒下粼粼银波。
沙岸平旷，水声止息，声影俱绝，
我举起一杯酒劝你，你应当为我高歌。
你的歌声酸楚，歌词悲苦，
还没等听完，我已经泪如雨下。
洞庭湖水连天，九嶷山高耸入云，
蛟龙在水中出没，猩猩鼯鼠在山中哀号。
九死一生才到达贬官的任所，
默默幽居躲藏，像个逃犯一样。
下床怕踩到毒蛇，吃饭怕食物有毒，
南方海气潮湿，蛰伏的毒虫散发出腥臊恶臭。
前些日子州府前擂起了大鼓，
新皇即位，提拔贤才如夔和皋陶。
大赦诏书一日之间传行了万里，
死罪以下的犯人全部免除死刑。
贬官的召回，流放的还乡，
朝廷清除奸佞，整顿朝班。
州里申报了我的名字，却被观察使压制，
命运坎坷，只能移官到荆蛮之地。
判司是个卑小的官职，不堪言说，
稍有差错，就不免在尘埃中受鞭笞之苦。
一同被贬的人大多已经上路回京，
回朝的天路幽暗险峻，我难以追攀。
你的歌暂且停下，听我唱一支歌，
我的歌和你的歌大不相同。
baihua: 纤云四卷天无河，清风吹空月舒波。沙平水息声影绝，一桮相属君当歌。君歌声酸辞且苦，不能听终泪如雨。洞庭连天九疑高，蛟龙出没猩鼯号。十生九死到官所，幽居默默如藏逃。下床畏蛇食畏药，海气湿蛰熏腥臊。昨者州前搥大鼓，嗣皇继圣登夔臯。赦书一日行万里，罪从大辟皆除死。迁者追廻流者还，涤瑕荡垢清朝班。州家申名使家抑，坎轲祗得移荆蛮。判司卑官不堪说，未免捶楚尘埃间。同时辈流多上道，天路幽险难追攀。君歌且休听我歌，我歌今与君殊科。
en_lines: Thin clouds have rolled away on all sides, the Milky Way is hidden from view,
A fresh wind blows across the void, the moon spreads its silver waves.
Sands are level, waters stilled, all sound and shadow cease,
I lift a cup to pledge you—you should sing a song for me.
Your song is sour with grief, your words are bitter,
Before you finish, my tears fall like rain.
Dongting Lake stretches to the sky, Jiuyi Mountains rise high,
Flood dragons appear and vanish, apes and flying squirrels howl.
You escaped death nine times to reach your assigned post,
Living in silent seclusion as though hiding from pursuit.
You feared to step from bed for snakes, to eat for poison,
The sea air damp with hidden vermin reeked of foulness.
The other day before the prefecture great drums were beaten,
The new emperor ascends, promoting worthies like Kui and Gao.
The amnesty edict traveled ten thousand li in a single day,
All crimes below the death penalty were commuted.
The demoted were recalled, the exiled returned,
Blemishes were washed away, the court ranks were cleansed.
The prefecture submitted my name, but the commissioner suppressed it,
Frustrated by fate, I could only be transferred to this barbarian south.
A petty official's post is too low to speak of,
One cannot avoid beatings in the dust for the smallest fault.
Most of my fellow exiles have set out for the capital,
The road to heaven is dark and steep, too hard for me to climb.
Cease your song now and listen to mine,
My song tonight is of a different kind.

title: 山石
author: 韩愈
note: 《山石》是韩愈的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【山石】唐代韩愈所作的诗。
tr: 山石犖確行徑微，黃昏到寺蝙蝠飛。升堂坐階新雨足，芭蕉葉大支子肥。僧言古壁佛畫好，以火來照所見稀。鋪牀拂席置羹飯，疎糲亦足飽我飢。夜深靜臥百蟲絕，清月出嶺光入扉。天明獨去無道路，出入高下窮煙霏。山紅澗碧紛爛漫，時見松櫪皆十圍。當流赤足蹋澗石，水聲激激風吹衣。人生如此自可樂，豈必局束爲人鞿。嗟啊吾黨二三子，安得至老不更歸。

baihua_lines: 山石嶙峋险峻，山路狭窄蜿蜒，
黄昏时分来到寺庙，蝙蝠正在乱飞。
登上殿堂坐在台阶上，刚下过一场大雨，
芭蕉叶子阔大，栀子花也长得肥美。
僧人说古壁上的佛画画得很好，
举火照亮来看，却是依稀罕见。
铺好床、拂净席、摆上饭食，
粗茶淡饭也足以填饱我的饥肠。
夜深了静静躺下，各种虫鸣都停歇了，
清朗的月亮从山岭升起，月光照进了门扉。
天亮时我独自离去，辨不清道路，
在烟云中忽上忽下，走尽了崎岖山径。
山花火红，涧水碧绿，色彩烂漫，
不时可见粗壮的松树和栎树，都有十围那么粗。
我赤脚蹚过溪水，踩着涧中的石头，
水声激激作响，山风吹拂着我的衣裳。
人生在世能够如此，自然可乐，
何必受人拘束，像被缰绳套住一样？
唉！我的那几位志同道合的朋友啊，
怎么能到老了还不归隐山林呢？
baihua: 山石荦确行径微，黄昏到寺蝙蝠飞。升堂坐阶新雨足，芭蕉叶大支子肥。僧言古壁佛画好，以火来照所见稀。铺床拂席置羹饭，疎粝亦足饱我饥。夜深静卧百虫绝，清月出岭光入扉。天明独去无道路，出入高下穷烟霏。山红涧碧纷烂漫，时见松枥皆十围。当流赤足蹋涧石，水声激激风吹衣。人生如此自可乐，岂必局束为人鞿。嗟啊吾党二三子，安得至老不更归。
en_lines: Rocks are jagged and rough, the mountain path is narrow,
At dusk I reach the temple as bats fly about.
I enter the hall, sit on the steps after ample new rain,
Plantain leaves are broad, gardenia blossoms plump and full.
The monk says the ancient walls bear fine Buddhist paintings,
He holds a torch to show me—rare sights they are, though hard to see.
Beds are laid, mats brushed, soup and rice set out,
Coarse fare is enough to still my hunger.
Deep at night I lie stilled; all insect sounds have ceased,
A clear moon rises over the ridges, light streaming through the door.
At dawn I depart alone, the path unclear,
Going in and out of high and low, through endless mist and cloud.
Mountains are crimson red, streams emerald green, colors abound,
Pines and oaks ten spans in girth appear from time to time.
Barefoot I wade the stream, treading on the stones,
Water gurgles loudly, mountain wind blows my robes.
Life like this can be joyful in itself,
Why be harnessed and constrained by others?
Ah! My like-minded companions,
How can we grow old and never return to such a life?

【石鼓歌】唐代韩愈所作的诗。
tr: 張生手持石鼓文，勸我試作石鼓歌。少陵無人謫仙死，才薄將奈石鼓何。周綱陵遲四海沸，宣王憤起揮天戈。大開明堂受朝賀，諸侯劒佩鳴相磨。蒐于岐陽騁雄俊，萬里禽獸皆遮羅。鐫功勒成告萬世，鑿石作鼓隳嵯峨。從臣才藝咸第一，揀選撰刻留山阿。雨淋日炙野火燎，鬼物守護煩撝呵。公從何處得紙本，毫髮盡備無差訛。辭嚴義密讀難曉，字體不類隸與科。年深豈免有缺畫，快劒斫斷生蛟鼉。鸞翔鳳翥衆僊下，珊瑚碧樹交枝柯。金繩鐵索鎖紐壯，古鼎躍水龍騰梭。陋儒編詩不收入，二雅褊迫無委蛇。孔子西行不到秦，掎摭星宿遺羲娥。嗟予好古生苦晚，對此涕淚雙滂沱。憶昔初蒙博士徴，其年始改稱元和。故人從軍在右輔，爲我度量掘臼科。濯冠沐浴告祭酒，如此至寶存豈多。氊包席裹可立致，十鼓祗載數駱駝。薦諸太廟比郜鼎，光價豈止百倍過。聖恩若許留太學，諸生講解得切磋。觀經鴻都尚填咽，坐見舉國來奔波。剜苔剔蘚露節角，安置妥帖平不頗。大廈深簷與蓋覆，經歷久遠期無佗。中朝大官老於事，詎肯感激徒媕婀。牧童敲火牛礪角，誰復著手爲摩挲。日銷月鑠就埋沒，六年西顧空吟哦。羲之俗書趁姿媚，數紙尚可博白鵝。繼周八代爭戰罷，無人收拾理則那。方今太平日無事，柄任儒術崇丘軻。安能以此上論列，願借辨口如懸河。石鼓之歌止於此，嗚呼吾意其蹉跎。
appr: 《石鼓歌》是唐代韩愈所作的诗名篇。全诗共66句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《石鼓歌》历代传诵不衰，是韩愈诗歌风格的集中体现。

bg: 《石鼓歌》为唐代韩愈所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者韩愈在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《石鼓歌》主旨在于抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代韩愈的代表性作品之一。

baihua_lines: 张籍手里拿着石鼓文的拓本，
劝我试着写一首石鼓歌。
杜甫已经不在人世，李白也死了，
我才疏学浅，又能把石鼓怎么样呢？
周朝的纲纪衰败，四海沸腾，
周宣王愤然而起，挥动天戈平定叛乱。
大开明堂接受诸侯的朝贺，
诸侯们佩剑相磨，叮当作响。
在岐阳原野上大搜狩猎，驰骋雄俊，
万里之内的飞禽走兽都被网罗围猎。
镌刻功绩，告成于万世，
凿开高山巨石做成石鼓，毁掉了嵯峨的山峰。
随从臣子才艺都是第一流的，
挑选佳士撰写刻文，留在山弯之中。
雨淋日晒，野火焚烧，
全赖鬼神守护，烦劳它们呵护呵斥。
张公你是从哪里得到这个拓本的？
笔画丝毫不差，完全没有讹误。
文辞严谨，意义精密，读来难懂，
字体既不像隶书，也不像蝌蚪文。
年深日久，难免有笔画残缺，
却如利剑斩断了活的蛟龙鼍龙。
像鸾凤飞翔，众仙从天而降，
像珊瑚和玉树的枝干交错在一起。
像金绳铁索的钮锁那样雄壮有力，
像古鼎跃出水面，飞龙像织布梭一样腾空。
浅薄的儒生编《诗经》时没有把它收入，
二雅的内容偏狭局促，不够舒展恢弘。
孔子西行没有到过秦国，
他拾取了星宿，却漏掉了太阳和月亮。
可叹我爱好古物，偏偏生得太晚，
面对这些古物，我不禁涕泪滂沱。
想当初我刚被征召为国子监博士，
那年正是改年号为元和的第一年。
一位老朋友在右辅从军，
替我设计规划，挖掘安置石鼓的坑穴。
我洗冠沐浴，郑重地禀告祭酒，
说这样的至宝存世能有多少？
只要用毡子包、席子裹，立刻就能运来，
十只石鼓只需几匹骆驼就能驮载。
把它们进献到太庙，和郜鼎相比，
它们的光彩价值又岂止超过百倍？
如果圣恩准许留在太学，
太学生们就能讲解切磋。
东汉时人们去鸿都门观经尚且堵塞道路，
全国人都会争相前来奔波观看。
剜去苔藓，剔掉泥土，露出笔画的棱角，
安置得平平稳稳，不偏不倚。
放在大厦深檐下覆盖保护，
经历久远也不会有什么损坏。
可是朝中的大官们老于世故，
哪里肯热心此事，只是犹豫不决。
牧童在石鼓上敲石取火，牛在上面磨角，
还有谁会用手摩挲爱惜它们呢？
日月销蚀，它们渐渐就要被埋没了，
六年来我西望石鼓，空自吟叹。
王羲之的书法迎合世俗，追求姿媚，
他写几纸字还能换来一群白鹅。
周朝之后历经八代，战乱已经平息，
却没有人收拾整理，这叫人徒唤奈何。
如今天下太平，国家无事，
朝廷重用儒术，尊崇孔子和孟子。
怎么才能把这件事上奏给朝廷，
我愿借辩士的悬河之口来陈说。
石鼓之歌就写到这里吧，
唉，我的心意看来又要落空了。
baihua: 张生手持石鼓文，劝我试作石鼓歌。少陵无人谪仙死，才薄将奈石鼓何。周纲陵迟四海沸，宣王愤起挥天戈。大开明堂受朝贺，诸侯劒佩鸣相磨。搜于岐阳骋雄俊，万里禽兽皆遮罗。镌功勒成告万世，凿石作鼓隳嵯峨。从臣才艺咸第一，拣选撰刻留山阿。雨淋日炙野火燎，鬼物守护烦㧑呵。公从何处得纸本，毫发尽备无差讹。辞严义密读难晓，字体不类隶与科。年深岂免有缺画，快劒斫断生蛟鼍。鸾翔凤翥众僊下，珊瑚碧树交枝柯。金绳铁索锁纽壮，古鼎跃水龙腾梭。陋儒编诗不收入，二雅褊迫无委蛇。孔子西行不到秦，掎摭星宿遗羲娥。嗟予好古生苦晚，对此涕泪双滂沱。忆昔初蒙博士徴，其年始改称元和。故人从军在右辅，为我度量掘臼科。濯冠沐浴告祭酒，如此至宝存岂多。氊包席裹可立致，十鼓祗载数骆驼。荐诸太庙比郜鼎，光价岂止百倍过。圣恩若许留太学，诸生讲解得切磋。观经鸿都尚填咽，坐见举国来奔波。剜苔剔藓露节角，安置妥帖平不颇。大厦深簷与盖覆，经历久远期无佗。中朝大官老于事，讵肯感激徒媕婀。牧童敲火牛砺角，谁复著手为摩挲。日销月铄就埋没，六年西顾空吟哦。羲之俗书趁姿媚，数纸尚可博白鹅。继周八代争战罢，无人收拾理则那。方今太平日无事，柄任儒术崇丘轲。安能以此上论列，愿借辨口如悬河。石鼓之歌止于此，呜呼吾意其蹉跎。
en_lines: Master Zhang holds rubbings of the stone drum inscriptions,
And urges me to compose a Song of the Stone Drums.
Du Fu is gone, Li Bai the Banished Immortal is dead,
With my meager talent, what can I do for the stone drums?
The Zhou Dynasty's order collapsed, the four seas boiled,
King Xuan rose in wrath and swung his heavenly spear.
He opened the Grand Hall to receive court congratulations,
Feudal lords' swords clinked and jostled as they assembled.
He hunted at Qiyang, galloping heroic steeds,
For ten thousand li beasts and birds were caught in nets.
Merits were carved in stone to inform ten thousand generations,
Rocks were hewn into drums, razing the craggy peaks.
Attendant ministers possessed the finest talents,
Selected to compose and carve texts left in the mountain curves.
Rain-soaked, sun-scorched, burned by wildfires,
Only spirits and ghosts guarded them, shouting protection.
Sir, where did you obtain these paper rubbings?
Every stroke is complete, without the slightest error.
The diction is strict, meaning dense, hard to comprehend,
The script resembles neither clerical nor tadpole characters.
After so many years some strokes are missing,
Yet still like a sharp sword severing live crocodiles.
Like phoenixes soaring, immortals descending,
Like coral and jade trees with intertwining branches.
Strong as golden ropes, iron chains and mighty locks,
Like ancient cauldrons leaping from water, dragons flying like shuttles.
Shallow scholars compiling the Book of Songs did not include them,
The Two Elegies are narrow, lacking grandeur and scope.
Confucius traveled west but never reached Qin,
He gathered the stars but left out the sun and moon.
I sigh that I love antiquity yet was born too late,
Facing these relics my tears stream down in torrents.
I recall when I was first summoned as Academy Doctor,
That same year the reign title was changed to Yuanhe.
An old friend served in the military command of the right district,
He measured and planned to excavate the pits for the drums.
I washed my cap, bathed, and reported to the Director of Studies,
Pleading: how many such supreme treasures can exist?
Wrapped in felt, bound in mats, they could be brought at once,
Ten drums would need but a few camels to carry.
Presented to the Imperial Temple beside the Gao tripod,
Their glory and value would surpass it a hundredfold.
If imperial grace allowed them to stay in the Academy,
Students could explain and study them by mutual polish.
When classics were displayed at Hongdu Gate, crowds jammed the streets,
The whole nation would rush to see these treasures.
Moss scraped away, lichen picked clean, revealing strokes and angles,
Placed securely, level, straight, and stable.
Under a great hall with deep eaves for shelter,
They could endure for ages without further harm.
But the high ministers at court are old hands at affairs,
Who will be moved to act? They only hesitate and waver.
Shepherd boys strike stones for fire on them, oxen sharpen their horns,
Who will handle them with loving care?
Day by day, month by month worn away, they face oblivion,
For six years I have gazed west and sighed in vain.
Wang Xizhi's common script chased after graceful charm,
Yet a few pages of his calligraphy could buy a flock of white geese.
Eight dynasties have passed since Zhou, wars have ceased,
Yet no one gathers and preserves these—what can be done?
Now the empire is at peace, the days untroubled,
Confucian learning is honored, Confucius and Mencius revered.
How can this matter be brought to the court's attention?
I would borrow the eloquent tongue of a master debater to plead.
My Song of the Stone Drums ends here,
Alas—my hopes shall once again come to nothing.

title: 谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼
author: 韩愈
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
【谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼】唐代韩愈所作的诗。
tr: 五嶽祭秩皆三公，四方環鎮嵩當中。火維地荒足妖怪，天假神柄專其雄。噴雲泄霧藏半腹，雖有絕頂誰能窮。我來正逢秋雨節，陰氣晦昧無清風。潛心默禱若有應，豈非正直能感通。須臾靜掃衆峰出，仰見突兀撐青空。紫蓋連延接天柱，石廩騰擲堆祝融。森然魄動下馬拜，松柏一逕趨靈宮。粉牆丹柱動光彩，鬼物圖畫填青紅。升階傴僂薦脯酒，欲以菲薄明其衷。廟令老人識神意，睢盱偵伺能鞠躬。手持桮珓導我擲，云此最吉餘難同。竄逐蠻荒幸不死，衣食纔足甘長終。侯王將相望久絕，神縱欲福難爲功。夜投佛寺上高閣，星月掩暎雲朣朧。猿鳴鐘動不知曙，杲杲寒日生於東。
appr: 《谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼》是唐代韩愈所作的诗名篇。全诗共32句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼》历代传诵不衰，是韩愈诗歌风格的集中体现。
st:
【起·开篇】前8句起笔点题，铺陈场景与基调。
【承·铺陈】第9至16句承接延展，层层深入。
【转·转折】第17至24句笔锋一转，情感深化。
【合·收束】末8句点明题旨，呼应开篇，余韵悠长。

【日】日光意象，或写时光流逝，或抒壮怀豪情，或带迟暮之感。

bg: 《谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼》为唐代韩愈所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者韩愈在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《谒衡岳庙遂宿岳寺题门楼》主旨在于描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。；托物言志，借物抒怀，表达品格追求。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代韩愈的代表性作品之一。
